items.title: 1150億美元押注AI！邁威爾收購Lumentum 挑戰博通
items.title_en: $115 Billion Bet on AI! Marvell to Acquire Lumentum, Challenging Broadcom
paras: 客製化晶片大廠邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周一(2日)宣布，將以全股票交易收購光通訊元件製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)，含債務在內的交易總值達1,150億美元，為今年規模最大的併購案之一。邁威爾押注，科技巨頭持續擴建AI資料中心，連接晶片所需的高速光通訊元件將持續供不應求。這筆交易也將擴充邁威爾的產品線，使其更有本錢與博通(AVGO-US)爭奪訂單。
依協議，Lumentum每股換股對價為1,132美元，較10月28日併購消息曝光前的收盤價溢價23.9%，股權交易價值為1,025.4億美元。邁威爾估計，合併後雙方產品可觸及的市場規模將擴大至5,500億美元。周一美股盤前，邁威爾上漲2.8%，Lumentum則暫停交易。

從客製化晶片到高速光通訊 邁威爾擴大挑戰博通

邁威爾近年協助亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等科技巨頭開發客製化AI晶片與資料中心網路技術，市值已突破1,700億美元。相較之下，博通長期擔任Google的主要客製化晶片合作夥伴，還能一次供應多種AI資料中心硬體。Lumentum的規模約為邁威爾的一半，收購後，邁威爾除了能替客戶設計晶片，也能供應讓資料在晶片之間高速傳輸的光通訊元件。
邁威爾今年8月已打入Google供應鏈，簽約供應與Google自研AI處理器搭配使用的晶片。這項協議到2033會計年度為止，最高可為邁威爾帶來1,200億美元銷售額，Google也取得買進價值122億美元邁威爾股份的權利。Google母公司為Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)。
輝達(NVDA-US)今年稍早也分別向邁威爾和Lumentum各投資20億美元。輝達執行長黃仁勳6月點名邁威爾有望成為下一家市值突破1兆美元的企業，帶動其股價創新高。邁威爾全年營收已從2021會計年度的30億美元，增至2026會計年度的82億美元。

美國擬限中國光收發模組 Lumentum有望受惠

AI代理與聊天機器人應用增加，資料中心內數千顆晶片需要更快的光通訊連線。邁威爾今年2月才以35億美元完成收購Celestial AI，擴充光子技術業務。此次收購Lumentum，則是邁威爾自2021年以100億美元買下Inphi以來，規模最大的一筆交易。
Lumentum的競爭對手包括美國光通訊廠Coherent(COHR-US)及中國的中際旭創(300308-CN)。美國正研議禁止新的中國製光收發模組進入市場，若提案實施，部分需求可能轉向美國供應商，Lumentum也有望受惠。
自雙方洽談併購的消息於上月底曝光以來，Lumentum股價已下跌約8%，邁威爾則下跌約22%。這段期間，英特爾(INTC-US)財測疲弱，加劇晶片股的全面賣壓。
paras_en: Marvell Technology (MRVL-US), a major custom‑chip maker, announced on Monday (the 2nd) that it will acquire optical‑components manufacturer Lumentum (LITE-US) in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion including debt, making it one of the largest mergers of the year. Marvell is betting that tech giants will keep expanding AI data centers, creating sustained shortage for the high‑speed optical components needed to connect chips. The deal will also broaden Marvell’s product line, giving it more firepower to compete with Broadcom (AVGO-US) for orders.

Under the agreement, Lumentum’s share‑exchange price is $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium to its closing price before the acquisition news broke on Oct. 28, valuing the equity portion at $102.54 billion. Marvell estimates that the combined product portfolio will address a market of $550 billion after the merger. In pre‑market trading on Monday, Marvell rose 2.8% while Lumentum’s shares were halted.

From custom chips to high‑speed optics, Marvell expands its challenge to Broadcom. In recent years Marvell has helped tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN-US) develop custom AI chips and data‑center networking technology, pushing its market cap past $170 billion. By contrast, Broadcom has long been Google’s primary custom‑chip partner and can supply a range of AI data‑center hardware in one go. Lumentum is roughly half the size of Marvell, and after the acquisition Marvell will not only design chips for customers but also provide the optical components that enable ultra‑fast data transfer between chips.

Marvell entered Google’s supply chain in August, signing a contract to provide chips that work with Google’s in‑house AI processor. The agreement runs through fiscal 2033 and could generate up to $120 billion in sales for Marvell, while Google secures the right to purchase $12.2 billion worth of Marvell stock. Google’s parent is Alphabet (GOOGL-US, GOOG-US).

Earlier this year Nvidia (NVDA-US) invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang singled out Marvell in June as a candidate to become the next trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap company, sending its stock to new highs. Marvell’s annual revenue has grown from $3 billion in fiscal 2021 to $8.2 billion in fiscal 2026.

The U.S. is poised to limit Chinese optical transceiver modules, which could benefit Lumentum. Growing AI agents and chat‑bot usage mean thousands of chips in data centers need faster optical links. In February Marvell completed a $3.5 billion acquisition of Celestial AI to expand its photonics business. The Lumentum deal is Marvell’s largest since it bought Inphi for $10 billion in 2021.

Lumentum’s rivals include U.S. optics firm Coherent (COHR-US) and China’s Zhongji Xuchuang (300308-CN). The U.S. is considering a ban on new Chinese‑made optical transceiver modules entering the market; if enacted, some demand could shift to U.S. suppliers, potentially benefiting Lumentum.

Since the merger talks were disclosed at the end of last month, Lumentum’s share price has fallen about 8% and Marvell’s about 22%. During that period, Intel’s (INTC-US) weak guidance added to broad selling pressure on chip stocks.

items.title: 大量新興雲端業者將在1到3年內破產？Bernstein警告：商業模式存在「致命」風險
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資熱潮持續延燒，但新興雲端業者（Neocloud）可能正面臨一場尚未浮現的財務危機。Bernstein最新研究報告引述資料中心法律專家Jeffrey Moerdler的分析指出，Neocloud業者普遍存在長短期租約錯配問題，部分企業恐在未來1至3年內陸續破產，情況可能重演共享辦公室業者WeWork的崩潰模式。
Moerdler自1990年起專注於資料中心及數位基礎設施法律業務，目前帶領約10名律師的團隊，每年處理數百筆交易，同時經手約30至40個專案。
他直言，Neocloud的商業模式令人擔憂，形同「WeWork 2.0」。
問題在於，Neocloud業者通常簽訂長達15年的資料中心租約，但向客戶提供的算力服務合約卻短得多，可能只有幾天、幾週或幾個月，即使較長的合約也通常僅有1至3年。
一旦客戶不再續約，業者收入便可能中斷，卻仍須持續承擔長期租金與設施成本。
Moerdler預期，未來1至3年將有部分Neocloud業者陷入破產困境，尤其是規模較小、專注特定垂直產業的AI新創公司，例如專門服務律師事務所或服飾產業的業者，若無法創造足夠收入，將難以維持營運。

資料中心擔保從全額縮水至80% 開發商風險升高

除了租約期限錯配，資料中心融資與租賃合約中的信用擔保結構也正在改變，進一步增加開發商的財務風險。
Moerdler指出，約10個月前，一家超大型雲端服務商率先改變市場慣例，不再提供涵蓋全部租約義務的信用擔保，而是僅承諾擔保約80%的建設貸款。
換言之，超出貸款保障範圍的建設成本，以及其餘20%的貸款風險，都必須由開發商自行承擔。
更值得注意的是，這類擔保通常會在租約初始期間採直線法逐年攤銷。以10年期租約為例，到了第7年或第8年，原有擔保價值幾乎已經耗盡。
與此同時，擔保方也開始要求更廣泛的介入權（Step-in Rights），也就是在需要履行擔保義務時，能夠直接接管相關資料中心空間及電力資源。過去這類安排通常由擔保方與客戶私下協商，如今則逐漸納入正式租約條款。
Moerdler表示，過去10至12個月，他經手涉及超大型雲端業者、AI公司及晶片製造商信用增強的交易，無一例外都已從全額租約擔保轉向有限度擔保。
資料中心合約暗藏四大風險 開發商恐失去資產控制權
Moerdler也提醒，資料中心租約中有多項容易被忽略的條款，可能在日後造成重大損失。
首先是「隨意終止權」（Termination-for-Convenience），允許租戶在特定條件下，無須提出特定違約事由便可終止合約。這類條款經常出現在超大型雲端業者的標準合約中，卻可能讓開發商在投入大量建設成本後，仍面臨租約提前終止的風險。
其次是信用擔保額度不足或攤銷速度過快，導致租約進入後期時，開發商原本仰賴的信用保障已大幅減弱。
第三，租約轉讓也可能使原有信用保護失效。如果租戶將租約轉讓給第三方，卻未能同步保留原本的信用增強安排，開發商便可能失去重要的風險緩衝。
第四則是租戶取得過多園區控制權，包括擴張權、縮減權，以及限制開發商開發相鄰土地的權利，可能進一步削弱開發商對自有資產的處置彈性。
Moerdler分享一個案例指出，曾有客戶委託他審查一份Neocloud租約，他在一個週末內便提出約50項修改意見，並建議若對方不願接受其中四分之三的修改，就不應進行交易。
最終，Neocloud僅願意修改約10%至20%的條款，客戶因此決定放棄簽約。

Neocloud倒閉未必是壞事 關鍵在開發商能否收回設施

不過，Neocloud破產對資料中心開發商而言，也未必完全是負面結果。
Moerdler認為，如果開發商事先建立足夠的信用保障，在租戶倒閉後順利收回設施，反而可能取得成本更具競爭力的資料中心資產。
他以每兆瓦建設成本1,000萬美元為例，假設開發商事先取得相當於建設成本30%的信用增強保障，包括信用狀、現金保證金、預付款或投資級企業擔保，那麼即使Neocloud破產，開發商收回設施後，實際成本基礎便可降至每兆瓦700萬美元。
由於資料中心已經完工，開發商可以重新出租設施，並以低於其他每兆瓦建設成本超過1,000萬美元的競爭者的價格進入市場。
但這項策略有一個重要前提，就是開發商必須能夠迅速收回資產。Moerdler指出，在紐約等地，收回不動產可能耗時1至2年，期間將大幅削弱這種成本優勢。

電力取得時間成選址關鍵 超過48個月吸引力大減

隨著AI資料中心需求快速成長，資料中心選址的評估標準也出現轉變。Moerdler認為，過去業界重視地理位置，如今能否及時取得電力，才是決定資產價值的關鍵。
他將資料中心電力供應時程分為四個等級：12個月內可取得電力屬於最高級的「白金資產」；12至24個月為「黃金資產」；24至48個月為「白銀資產」；若等待時間超過48個月，商業吸引力便大幅下降。
舉例而言，一座規劃容量400兆瓦的資料中心園區，即使短期內只能取得100兆瓦電力，只要能在12至24個月內交付，且後續供電計畫具有可信度，仍具有相當高的投資價值。
他也指出，德州電力可靠度委員會（ERCOT）目前收到的待審電力申請量，已達德州電網現有容量的4倍，其中包含大量投機性申請。電力監管機構正透過押金及保證金要求，淘汰缺乏客戶、專業能力與資金支持的投機業者。

AI資料中心需求未降溫 城市型推理設施成新商機

儘管市場對AI基礎建設投資能否持續抱持疑慮，Moerdler根據目前經手的交易指出，資料中心需求仍呈現快速成長，尚未出現放緩跡象。
他透露，目前正在處理的專案包括德州一座3吉瓦（GW）資料中心園區，以及一筆出售德州Batch Zero資料中心園區的交易，規模超過2吉瓦，交易金額約20億美元。
不過，市場參與者對投機性交易的風險意識也明顯提高，承銷與融資標準正逐步趨嚴。
展望未來3至5年，Moerdler預期，隨著大型AI模型訓練需求逐漸趨於飽和，市場將有更多需求轉向城市及近郊的小型AI推理節點。
他指出，過去幾年資料中心產業經歷大量併購，中型營運商數量大幅減少，導致250千瓦至2兆瓦規模的在地資料中心供給不足，相關租賃價格過去兩年已上漲50%至100%。
Moerdler並透露，近期已在紐約市區完成一筆2兆瓦資料中心租約，承租方是一家AI推理設施業者。這也反映出，在大型AI訓練設施持續擴張之際，鄰近城市的小型推理運算基礎設施，正逐漸成為資料中心市場的新成長機會。

items.title: 00949擬配3.02元配息率衝破13% 掀起日股ETF高息話題
items.title_en: 00949 Plans NT$3.02 Dividend, Yield Over 13% Sparks High‑Yield Japanese‑Stock ETF Talk
paras: 近期全球科技股波動加劇，市場資金開始重新檢視投資組合的風險分散與收益來源。日股ETF配息表現也成為市場關注焦點，其中復華日本龍頭(00949-TW)最新宣布配發每受益權單位3.02元，以今(2)日收盤價 22.1 元推算，年配息率突破 13%，不僅展現亮眼的收益表現，更寫下台灣掛牌日股ETF的配息新紀錄。
過去台灣掛牌的日本股票ETF，多以追蹤日本主要股價指數、掌握日股長期成長機會為訴求，配息並非市場關注的主要焦點。相較之下，00949此次宣布配發3.02元，以推估年配息率超過13%的水準來看，明顯有別於過往日股ETF的配息表現。若與市場既有日股ETF歷史配息紀錄比較，過去尚未出現年化配息率突破10%的案例，此次配息因此格外受到矚目。
值得注意的是，近期美國大型科技股及AI相關族群受到市場對企業資本支出、獲利成長與評價水準的重新檢視，股價波動明顯加大。在全球股市連動性提高的環境下，投資人若過度集中於單一市場或科技產業，投資組合可能承受較大的短期波動。因此，透過不同國家與產業的資產配置分散風險，重要性也隨之提升。
日本股市近年受惠於企業治理改革、股東報酬意識提升，以及企業積極推動資本效率改善，逐漸吸引國際資金關注。相較於高度集中在少數大型科技企業的投資組合，日本市場涵蓋金融、工業、消費、汽車及電子等多元產業，可作為投資人拓展海外股票配置的選項之一。
市場人士指出，對於已持有美股科技ETF、台灣科技型ETF或AI相關投資部位的投資人而言，適度納入日股ETF，不僅有助於拓展投資區域，也能增加不同產業與企業獲利來源的曝險。若搭配具備配息機制的產品，更可兼顧海外股市參與及現金流需求，提升投資組合的配置彈性。
不過，投資人仍須留意，ETF配息率並不等同於投資報酬率，單次高額配息也不代表未來能持續維持相同水準。評估日股ETF時，除觀察配息金額與年化配息率外，也應綜合考量基金淨值變化、配息來源、總報酬表現、匯率風險及標的指數特性，避免單純以高配息率作為投資依據。

paras_en: Recent global tech‑stock volatility has intensified, prompting investors to re‑examine portfolio risk diversification and sources of return. The dividend performance of Japanese‑stock ETFs in Taiwan has become a market focus, and Fu‑Hua Japan Leader (00949‑TW) just announced a distribution of NT$3.02 per unit. Using today’s (the 2nd) closing price of NT$22.1, the annualized dividend yield exceeds 13%, setting a new dividend record for Taiwan‑listed Japanese‑stock ETFs.

Historically, Taiwan‑listed Japanese equity ETFs have mainly tracked Japan’s major indices and emphasized long‑term growth opportunities, with dividends not being a primary market focus. In contrast, 00949’s announcement of a NT$3.02 payout, implying an annualized yield above 13%, is markedly different from past Japanese‑stock ETF dividend performance. Compared with historical yields of existing Japanese‑stock ETFs, none have ever broken a 10% annualized dividend yield, making this payout especially noteworthy.

It is worth noting that large U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks have recently faced renewed scrutiny over capital expenditures, profit growth, and valuation levels, leading to markedly higher price volatility. In an environment of heightened global market correlation, investors overly concentrated in a single market or tech sector may experience larger short‑term swings. Hence, diversifying across countries and industries becomes increasingly important for risk mitigation.

Japan’s stock market has benefited in recent years from corporate governance reforms, heightened shareholder‑pay awareness, and active efforts to improve capital efficiency, gradually attracting international capital. Compared with portfolios heavily weighted toward a few large tech firms, Japan offers a broader mix of financials, industrials, consumer, automotive and electronics sectors, providing investors with another option for overseas equity allocation.

Market participants note that investors already holding U.S. tech ETFs, Taiwan tech‑focused ETFs, or AI‑related positions can benefit from modestly adding Japanese‑stock ETFs. This not only broadens geographic exposure but also adds exposure to different industries and corporate earnings sources. When paired with dividend‑paying products, it can satisfy both overseas market participation and cash‑flow needs, enhancing portfolio flexibility.

However, investors should remember that an ETF’s dividend yield is not equivalent to its total return, and a one‑time large payout does not guarantee future consistency. When evaluating Japanese‑stock ETFs, beyond the dividend amount and annualized yield, one should also consider NAV changes, dividend sources, total return performance, currency risk, and the characteristics of the underlying index, avoiding reliance solely on high yields as an investment basis.

items.title: 十銓：記憶體缺貨尚未達高峰「到明年Q2最吃緊」 千坪新廠估增5成產能
items.title_en: TenQ: Memory Shortage Not Yet at Peak, "Tightest Until Q2 Next Year" New 1,000-Ping Factory Expected to Boost Capacity by 50%
paras: 記憶體模組廠十銓(4967-TW)今(2)日召開法說，公司表示，這波記憶體景氣循環與過去不同，主要受到產業結構改變、原廠及模組廠寡占化影響，價格已連漲一年，短期內看不到反轉跡象，且真正缺貨最嚴重的時刻還沒到，預估今年第四季至明年第二季末將是供貨最吃緊的階段，不排除出現有錢也買不到貨的情況。
十銓表示，目前全球記憶體供應主要集中在三星、美光及SK海力士，台灣及中國大陸業者雖持續擴產，但短期產量仍不足以左右整體市場供需，加上主要模組廠也逐漸寡占化，價格主導能力提高，使這波景氣循環不同於過去每兩至六個月就出現一次波動的情況，短期內價格仍有支撐。
十銓指出，第四季至明年第一季記憶體價格仍將持續上漲，部分缺貨較嚴重的產品，過去每季合約價格漲幅約30%至40%，預期漲勢仍將延續。其中，LPDDR5X隨著應用從手機擴大至新一代AI運算設備，單一設備搭載量提高，也進一步推升需求。
供貨方面，十銓與各大原廠合作近30年，透過長期交易紀錄及長期供貨協議(LTA)爭取貨源。截至第三季底，庫存金額約172億元，其中DRAM占75%、NAND Flash占25%，後續將以伺服器、工控長期訂單客戶及高階消費性產品為主要備貨方向，採取邊買邊賣策略，買得到多少就供應多少。
消費性市場方面，十銓表示，手機及一般PC在記憶體供貨分配上相對處於劣勢，PC業者已透過降低記憶體規格控制整機成本，預期明年情況仍難明顯改善，消費性模組市場可能要到2028年下半年才有機會迎來轉機。
面對記憶體市場結構轉變，十銓也同步調整營運組織，將既有業務整合為企業暨工控應用、品牌暨通路兩大事業群。其中，企業暨工控應用事業群聚焦伺服器記憶體、企業級SSD、工控及邊緣AI應用，強化產品驗證導入與技術服務；品牌暨通路事業群則運用逾20年全球品牌及通路經營經驗，鎖定高階電競、專業工作站及創作者市場，深化系統整合商(SI)與通路夥伴合作。
至於毛利率持續走高，十銓指出，除了記憶體售價上漲，也受惠於產品及客戶組合轉變，B2B營收比重已提高至約65%，逐步轉向AI伺服器、工業電腦及高技術門檻應用。由於這類客戶對價格的承受度較高，且長期訂單逐漸增加，加上庫存成本與銷售價格的時間差，有助於支撐整體獲利表現，且目前庫存操作維持健康，隨產品組合持續朝高階應用發展，對後續毛利率仍具信心。
為支援企業級及工控業務發展，十銓也在新北市新購約千坪廠房，規劃導入自動化生產設備，以因應少量多樣的產品需求。新廠預計2027年第一季展開裝修及設備進駐，第二季完工投產，屆時可增加約50%產能，並透過兩座工廠的生產調度提高製程彈性。同時，透過兩大事業群分工，深化高階消費性產品及全球通路經營，同時擴大企業級與工控應用布局，配合新廠投產增加產能，掌握記憶體市場需求及產業轉型商機。
paras_en: Memory module maker TenQ (4967-TW) held a briefing today, stating that the current memory cycle differs from the past, driven by industry structural changes and increasing concentration among OEMs and module makers. Prices have risen continuously for a year, with no short‑term reversal in sight, and the most severe shortage has not yet arrived. The company forecasts that the tightest supply period will be from Q4 this year through the end of Q2 next year, and it may even reach a point where money cannot secure inventory.

TenQ noted that global memory supply is now dominated by Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix. Although Taiwanese and mainland Chinese players are expanding capacity, their short‑term output remains insufficient to sway overall market balance. Meanwhile, the consolidation of major module manufacturers is enhancing price‑setting power, making this cycle unlike the past where fluctuations occurred every two to six months, and price support is expected to persist in the near term.

The firm expects memory prices to keep rising through Q4 and into Q1 next year. For products experiencing the sharpest shortages, contract prices have historically jumped 30‑40% each quarter, and this upward trend is expected to continue. In particular, LPDDR5X demand is being boosted as its use expands from smartphones to next‑generation AI computing devices, increasing the per‑device memory count.

On the supply side, TenQ has partnered with major OEMs for nearly 30 years, leveraging long‑term transaction records and long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to secure shipments. By the end of Q3, inventory was valued at about NT$17.2 billion, with DRAM accounting for 75% and NAND flash 25%. Going forward, the company will prioritize stocking for server, industrial‑control long‑term orders and high‑end consumer products, adopting a buy‑as‑you‑sell approach – supplying as much as it can procure.

In the consumer market, TenQ said that smartphones and typical PCs are at a disadvantage in memory allocation. PC makers have been lowering memory specifications to control system costs, and the situation is unlikely to improve noticeably next year. The consumer module market may not see a turnaround until the second half of 2028.

Facing the shift in memory market structure, TenQ is reorganizing its operations, consolidating existing sales into two business groups: Enterprise & Industrial Applications and Brand & Channel. The former focuses on server memory, enterprise‑grade SSDs, industrial control and edge AI, strengthening product validation and technical services; the latter leverages over 20 years of global brand and channel experience to target high‑end gaming, professional workstations and creator markets, deepening cooperation with system integrators and channel partners.

Regarding rising gross margins, TenQ attributed the improvement not only to higher memory prices but also to a shift in product and customer mix. B2B revenue now makes up about 65% of sales, moving toward AI servers, industrial PCs and high‑tech applications. These customers have higher price tolerance and growing long‑term orders, and the timing gap between inventory cost and sales price supports overall profitability. Inventory remains healthy, and as the product mix continues toward high‑end applications, the company remains confident about future margins.

To support its enterprise and industrial businesses, TenQ is acquiring a roughly 1,000‑ping (≈3,300 sqm) plant in New Taipei City, planning to install automated production equipment to meet low‑volume, high‑variety demand. The new factory is slated for renovation and equipment installation in Q1 2027, with completion and start‑up in Q2, boosting capacity by about 50%. Coordinated production across the two sites will enhance process flexibility, while the two business groups will deepen high‑end consumer product and global channel operations, expand enterprise and industrial application coverage, and capture memory market demand and transformation opportunities.

items.title: AI高速傳輸需求升溫 法人看好眾達-KY 400G、800G產品放量
items.title_en: AI High-Speed Transmission Demand Rises, Institutional Investors Favor Zhongda-KY’s 400G and 800G Products Scaling Up
paras: 台股光通訊廠眾達-KY (4977-TW) 受惠於雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI基礎建設投資，帶動資料中心高速傳輸需求快速升溫。隨著各大CSP對高階網路交換器的傳輸速率要求不斷提升，產業規格正加速朝400G、800G世代推進。法人預估，眾達-KY明(2027)年400G產品將持續放量，800G產品也將逐步跟上，成為推升公司營運成長的主要動能。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前市場關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，以及公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(Broadcom)的合作布局，相關發展也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
隨著AI伺服器運算規模持續擴大，資料傳輸瓶頸已成為資料中心建置的重要課題。當傳輸速率由400G邁向800G，甚至進一步朝1.6T發展，資料傳輸架構也逐漸走向光電整合、光銅並進的趨勢。其中，短距離傳輸仍以銅纜為主，以兼顧成本與功耗；中長距離及高頻寬傳輸需求，則更多仰賴光通訊技術支援，帶動高速光收發模組的滲透率持續提升，成為AI資料中心升級的重要環節。
從眾達-KY目前產品營收結構來看，400G及800G產品合計已占營收約六成。其中，法人預估400G產品營收占比約達40%至50%，800G產品則隨出貨逐步升溫，營收貢獻持續增加，未來占比可望進一步擴大，成為公司產品組合升級及營運成長的重要支柱。
法人表示，眾達-KY正積極投入矽光子相關應用技術的產品發展活動，配合公司長期合作夥伴博通的研發進度，預計順利完成客戶認證後，有望開始正式放量投產。
paras_en: Taiwan’s optical communications maker Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW) is benefiting from cloud service providers (CSPs) continuously expanding AI infrastructure investments, which is heating up demand for high‑speed data‑center transmission. As major CSPs raise the required transmission rates of high‑end network switches, industry standards are rapidly moving toward the 400G and 800G generations. Institutional investors estimate that Zhongda‑KY’s 400G products will keep ramping up in 2027, with 800G products following suit, becoming a key driver of the company’s operational growth.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules. Market attention is now centered on the shipment progress of high‑end 400G and 800G products and the company’s collaborative layout with Broadcom in laser‑optical packaging, which has become an important indicator for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

As AI server compute scales continue to expand, data‑transfer bottlenecks have become a critical issue for data‑center construction. When transmission rates move from 400G toward 800G—and eventually toward 1.6T—the data‑transfer architecture is shifting toward a hybrid of photonic integration and copper. Short‑reach transmission remains copper‑cable‑dominant to balance cost and power consumption, while mid‑ to long‑reach, high‑bandwidth needs rely increasingly on optical‑communication technology, driving higher penetration of high‑speed optical transceiver modules and becoming a vital link in AI data‑center upgrades.

Looking at Zhongda‑KY’s current product revenue mix, 400G and 800G products together already account for about 60% of revenue. Institutional investors estimate that 400G contributes roughly 40%–50% of revenue, while 800G’s share is rising as shipments heat up, with its contribution expected to grow further and become a major pillar of the company’s product portfolio upgrade and operational growth.

Institutions note that Zhongda‑KY is actively investing in silicon‑photonics‑related application technologies, aligning with its long‑term partner Broadcom’s R&D timeline. After successful customer certification, the company expects to commence full‑scale production and volume ramp‑up.

items.title: 高盛上調年底與明年油價預測 稱「供應風險加劇」
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Raises Year‑End and Next‑Year Oil Price Forecasts, Says “Supply Risk Intensifies”
paras: 鑑於中東戰事延續導致原油供應風險升溫，高盛正式上調今年底與2027年的油價預測，加入其他華爾街大型投行調升原油展望的行列。
高盛分析師Daan Struyven與Yulia Zhestkova Grigsby等人在11月1日發布的報告中指出，12月布蘭特原油期貨預估值已從每桶90美元上調至105美元，2027年均價則調升10%至每桶88美元，並同步上調美國西德州中級原油(WTI)的預測。
分析師團隊寫道：「實質的供應下行風險可能持續維持顯著的近期風險溢價。」他們補充說明，金融市場正給予「11月3日美國期中選舉後局勢升級，以及隨之而來的中東供應潛在疲軟」愈來愈高的權重。
Struyven與Grigsby進一步分析，航運襲擊加劇與基礎設施受損均可能觸發油價進一步上揚，同時也提及俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭帶來的相關風險。分析師表示：「由於中斷發生的時間與地點極難預測，我們的基準情境已納入2027年全球每日100萬桶的供應中斷衝擊量。」
儘管中東原油供應已回升至接近戰前水準，布蘭特原油10月仍大漲14%並創下6個月新高。主要原因在於市場擔憂美伊敵對狀態可能在期中選舉後激化，美國總統川普多次暗示可能恢復空襲行動，而伊朗最高領袖則已下令軍方高層指揮官準備迎接新一輪對抗。
除了核心基準看法，高盛也描繪了價格區間達70美元的看多與看空情境。分析師指出，在看多情境下，若波斯灣日產量持續比去年平均低350萬桶，明年布蘭特均價可能高達每桶130美元；但在區域產能加速恢復的看空情境中，期貨價格則「可能跌至60多美元區間」。
此外，摩根士丹利已將第四季現貨布蘭特預估調高至每桶105美元，澳盛銀行(ANZ Group Holdings Ltd.)也將年底布蘭特期貨目標價調升至同等水準，而本周一交易中主力合約則拉回至110美元下方。
paras_en: Given the ongoing Middle‑East conflict that has heightened crude‑oil supply risks, Goldman Sachs formally raised its oil price forecasts for the end of this year and for 2027, joining other major Wall Street banks in lifting their outlooks for crude.

Goldman analysts Daan Struyven and Yulia Zhestkova Grigsby and colleagues noted in a report released on November 1 that the December Brent futures estimate was lifted from $90 a barrel to $105, and the 2027 average price was raised 10% to $88 a barrel, with a corresponding upward revision for U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI).

The analyst team wrote: “The substantive supply‑downside risk could continue to sustain a significant near‑term risk premium.” They added that financial markets are assigning increasing weight to “the escalation of the situation after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3 and the resulting potential weakness in Middle‑East supply.”

Struyven and Grigsby further explained that intensified shipping attacks and damaged infrastructure could trigger further price gains, and they also referenced risks stemming from Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. The analysts said: “Because the timing and location of disruptions are extremely hard to predict, our baseline scenario incorporates a shock of one million barrels per day of global supply interruption in 2027.”

Although Middle‑East crude supply has rebounded to near pre‑conflict levels, Brent surged 14% in October, hitting a six‑month high. The main driver was market concern that U.S.–Iran hostilities could flare after the midterms, with former President Trump repeatedly hinting at a possible resumption of air strikes and Iran’s supreme leader ordering senior military commanders to prepare for a new round of confrontation.

Beyond its core view, Goldman also outlined bullish and bearish price ranges around $70. Analysts noted that in a bullish scenario, if daily Persian Gulf output remains 3.5 million barrels below last year’s average, Brent’s average price next year could reach as high as $130 a barrel; in a bearish scenario where regional capacity recovers quickly, futures could “drop into the $60‑plus” range.

In addition, Morgan Stanley has lifted its fourth‑quarter spot Brent estimate to $105 a barrel, ANZ Group Holdings Ltd. has raised its year‑end Brent futures target to the same level, and the front‑month contract traded this Monday fell back below $110.

items.title: 台積電供應鏈迅得對半導體設備出貨走揚 10月營收改寫歷史次高
items.title_en: TSMC Supply Chain's Shunde Sees Semiconductor Equipment Shipments Rise, October Revenue Rewrites Historic Second‑Highest
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈設備大廠迅得(6438-TW)營收在半導體業務推進一如預期，10 月營收維持在 6 億元以上高檔，今(2)日揭露以 6.73億元改寫歷史單月次高，也創同期新高，月減3.15%、年增28.08%；累計 2026 年 1-10 月營收達61.86億元，年增 10.93%。
迅得 2026 年第三季營收達 19.45 億元，季增 6.64%、年增 13.62%，單季營收刷新歷史紀錄。法人預估，第四季營收將可維持在此一歷史高檔水準之上。
迅得投資 1.5 億元取得南科友上科技 23% 股權後，公司高層透露，目前仍有其他投資案持續推進中。同時，為因應持續湧入的設備訂單，迅得最快將於今年底至明年初在台灣南部取得土地興建新廠，全面提升產能供給。
在營運效益方面，迅得營運總部遷入新生廠後產能已達滿載，進一步推升獲利表現。2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，毛利率 26.13%，稅後純益 3.11 億元，每股純益(EPS)達 3.79 元。2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創高，稅後純益 1.66 億元，優於首季的 1.45 億元，單季 EPS 為 2.03 元。
隨著迅得安排出貨的半導體設備於第四季步入出貨高峰，加上產品組合優化，下半年營運將顯著優於上半年。法人預估，迅得 2026 全年營收將較 2025 年的 64.67 億元成長 10%–15%，續創歷史新高；在產品組合有利因素加持下，獲利成長幅度更有望達到營收增幅的倍數呈現。
迅得同時具備半導體與 PCB 設備雙重成長動能，在 PCB 領域，公司鎖定高階載板與板廠需求，目前已握有臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及景碩(3189-TW)等大廠確立訂單。
paras_en: Shunde (6438‑TW), a major equipment supplier in TSMC's supply chain, saw semiconductor business advance as expected, with October revenue staying above NT$600 million. Today (2nd) it disclosed NT$673 million, rewriting the historic single‑month second‑highest and setting a new high for the period, down 3.15% month‑over‑month, up 28.08% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for Jan‑Oct 2026 reached NT$6.186 billion, up 10.93% YoY.
Shunde's Q3 2026 revenue hit NT$1.945 billion, up 6.64% sequentially and 13.62% YoY, a quarterly record. Analysts estimate Q4 revenue will stay above this historic high level.

After investing NT$150 million to acquire a 23% stake in Youshang Technology of the Southern Science Park, management said other investment projects are still progressing. To cope with the influx of equipment orders, Shunde plans to acquire land in southern Taiwan by year‑end to early next year to build a new plant, fully boosting capacity.

On the operational side, after moving its headquarters to the new plant, capacity is now fully utilized, further improving profitability. H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% YoY, gross margin 26.13%, net profit NT$311 million, EPS NT$3.79. Q2 2026 revenue reached a record NT$1.824 billion, net profit NT$166 million, higher than Q1’s NT$145 million, with quarterly EPS of NT$2.03.

With Shunde’s semiconductor equipment shipments entering a peak in Q4 and product‑mix optimization, H2 performance is expected to be markedly better than H1. Analysts project 2026 full‑year revenue to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, setting a new historic high; profit growth could outpace revenue growth, potentially multiples of the revenue increase.

Shunde also has dual growth drivers in semiconductor and PCB equipment. In the PCB segment, the company targets high‑end substrates and fab demand, and has already secured orders from major players such as Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW).

items.title: 00980A受益人數暴增近130% 年化配息率12%
items.title_en: 00980A Beneficiary Numbers Surge Nearly 130% Annual Yield 12%
paras: 外資在上月賣超台股9,943.17億元，創下歷史最高單月賣超紀錄。台股從月初光輝十月行情，一度衝上49,968.92點，距五萬點大關僅一步之遙，隨後卻在高利率、AI投資回收疑慮與外資賣壓交織下震盪走低，並於最後一個交易日跌破半年線成悲傷十月，美股更是慘遭血血洗。面對劇烈波動，主動野村台灣優選（00980A-TW）受益人數年增近130%，今(2) 日公布第一階段收益分配公告，每單位擬配發0.688元，按今日收盤價22.79元換算，單次配息率為3.02%，年化配息率為12.08%。
00980A本次除息交易日為11月17日，最後買進日為11月16日，收益分配預計於12月11日發放。
觀察2020年以來不含本次之十大外資賣超月份，平均單月賣超金額達4,655.27億元，加權指數當月平均下跌4.95%；但若將時間拉長至六個月，加權指數則平均上漲17.48%。野村投信表示，外資集中賣超雖可能加重短期市場壓力，中期行情仍須回歸企業獲利與產業趨勢觀察，投資人可在震盪中檢視基本面，評估分批布局機會。
00980A基金經理人游景德表示，今年台股較大幅度的震盪集中在4月、7月與10月，適逢季報公布與美國大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）擴大資本支出的時點，反映市場對AI融資成本與投資延續性的關注。不過，最新科技巨頭財報顯示，雲端與AI需求仍持續成長，五大CSP明年資本支出預估上修至1.3兆美元，AI基礎建設投資循環尚未見頂。
游景德指出，野村投信內部股票池預估，2026年企業每股盈餘年增率已上修至80.3%，連續10個月上修；新一代AI平台Vera Rubin於今年第四季末至明年第一季初進入量產，可望帶動相關供應鏈營收成長。儘管個別公司訂單與產品規格調整的消息可能影響市場情緒，台灣廠商在伺服器滑軌、ABF載板及散熱等領域的競爭優勢仍具支撐，投資人可透過定期定額分散進場時點，依資金規劃逢低分批加碼。
00980A採季配息機制，成立於2025年4月22日，為台股首檔主動式ETF，受益人數已達71,476人，較去年同期成長129.68%。
paras_en: Foreign investors sold Taiwanese stocks worth NT$9,943.17 billion last month, setting a record for the highest single‑month net sell‑off. The market, which had risen to 49,968.92 points early in the month and was just a step away from the 50,000‑point milestone, later slipped amid high interest rates, concerns over AI investment returns and foreign‑investor selling pressure, breaking below the six‑month moving average on the final trading day and delivering a sad October, while U.S. stocks suffered a brutal sell‑off. Amid the volatility, Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW) saw its beneficiary count rise by almost 130% year‑over‑year and today (the 2nd) announced the first‑stage dividend distribution, proposing a payout of NT$0.688 per unit, which translates to a one‑time yield of 3.02% based on today’s closing price of NT$22.79 and an annualised yield of 12.08%.
The ex‑dividend date for 00980A is November 17, the last purchase day is November 16, and the dividend distribution is scheduled for December 11.

Looking at the ten months with the largest foreign‑investor net sell‑offs since 2020 (excluding the current one), the average monthly net sell‑off was NT$4,655.27 billion and the weighted index fell an average of 4.95% that month; however, over a six‑month horizon the index rose an average of 17.48%. Nomura Asset Management says that while concentrated foreign selling may increase short‑term pressure, the medium‑term market will revert to fundamentals such as corporate earnings and industry trends, and investors can use the volatility to assess fundamentals and evaluate opportunities for staggered positioning.

Fund manager You Jing‑de of 00980A noted that this year’s major swings in the Taiwan market were concentrated in April, July and October, coinciding with quarterly earnings releases and the timing of increased capital expenditures by major U.S. cloud service providers (CSPs), reflecting market focus on AI financing costs and investment continuity. Nevertheless, the latest earnings from tech giants show that cloud and AI demand remain robust, with the five largest CSPs revising next‑year cap‑ex forecasts up to $1.3 trillion, indicating the AI infrastructure investment cycle has not peaked yet.

You Jing‑de added that Nomura’s internal stock pool now projects the 2026 corporate earnings per share growth rate up to 80.3%, a revision sustained for ten consecutive months. The next‑generation AI platform Vera Rubin is expected to enter mass production from late Q4 this year into early Q1 next year, which should boost revenue for related supply‑chain firms. Although news of order changes or product specifications at individual companies may sway sentiment, Taiwanese manufacturers retain competitive advantages in server rails, ABF substrates and cooling solutions, supporting the sector. Investors can adopt a regular‑interval, dollar‑cost‑averaging approach to add positions on dips according to their capital plans.

00980A employs a quarterly dividend policy, was launched on April 22 2025, and is Taiwan’s first actively managed ETF. Its beneficiary count has reached 71,476, up 129.68% from the same period last year.

items.title: 00949擬配3.02元配息率衝破13% 掀起日股ETF高息話題
items.title_en: 00949 Plans NT$3.02 Dividend, Yield Over 13% Sparks High‑Yield Japanese‑Stock ETF Talk
paras: 近期全球科技股波動加劇，市場資金開始重新檢視投資組合的風險分散與收益來源。日股ETF配息表現也成為市場關注焦點，其中復華日本龍頭(00949-TW)最新宣布配發每受益權單位3.02元，以今(2)日收盤價 22.1 元推算，年配息率突破 13%，不僅展現亮眼的收益表現，更寫下台灣掛牌日股ETF的配息新紀錄。
過去台灣掛牌的日本股票ETF，多以追蹤日本主要股價指數、掌握日股長期成長機會為訴求，配息並非市場關注的主要焦點。相較之下，00949此次宣布配發3.02元，以推估年配息率超過13%的水準來看，明顯有別於過往日股ETF的配息表現。若與市場既有日股ETF歷史配息紀錄比較，過去尚未出現年化配息率突破10%的案例，此次配息因此格外受到矚目。
值得注意的是，近期美國大型科技股及AI相關族群受到市場對企業資本支出、獲利成長與評價水準的重新檢視，股價波動明顯加大。在全球股市連動性提高的環境下，投資人若過度集中於單一市場或科技產業，投資組合可能承受較大的短期波動。因此，透過不同國家與產業的資產配置分散風險，重要性也隨之提升。
日本股市近年受惠於企業治理改革、股東報酬意識提升，以及企業積極推動資本效率改善，逐漸吸引國際資金關注。相較於高度集中在少數大型科技企業的投資組合，日本市場涵蓋金融、工業、消費、汽車及電子等多元產業，可作為投資人拓展海外股票配置的選項之一。
市場人士指出，對於已持有美股科技ETF、台灣科技型ETF或AI相關投資部位的投資人而言，適度納入日股ETF，不僅有助於拓展投資區域，也能增加不同產業與企業獲利來源的曝險。若搭配具備配息機制的產品，更可兼顧海外股市參與及現金流需求，提升投資組合的配置彈性。
不過，投資人仍須留意，ETF配息率並不等同於投資報酬率，單次高額配息也不代表未來能持續維持相同水準。評估日股ETF時，除觀察配息金額與年化配息率外，也應綜合考量基金淨值變化、配息來源、總報酬表現、匯率風險及標的指數特性，避免單純以高配息率作為投資依據。

paras_en: Recent global tech‑stock volatility has intensified, prompting investors to re‑examine portfolio risk diversification and sources of return. The dividend performance of Japanese‑stock ETFs in Taiwan has become a market focus, and Fu‑Hua Japan Leader (00949‑TW) just announced a distribution of NT$3.02 per unit. Using today’s (the 2nd) closing price of NT$22.1, the annualized dividend yield exceeds 13%, setting a new dividend record for Taiwan‑listed Japanese‑stock ETFs.

Historically, Taiwan‑listed Japanese equity ETFs have mainly tracked Japan’s major indices and emphasized long‑term growth opportunities, with dividends not being a primary market focus. In contrast, 00949’s announcement of a NT$3.02 payout, implying an annualized yield above 13%, is markedly different from past Japanese‑stock ETF dividend performance. Compared with historical yields of existing Japanese‑stock ETFs, none have ever broken a 10% annualized dividend yield, making this payout especially noteworthy.

It is worth noting that large U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks have recently faced renewed scrutiny over capital expenditures, profit growth, and valuation levels, leading to markedly higher price volatility. In an environment of heightened global market correlation, investors overly concentrated in a single market or tech sector may experience larger short‑term swings. Hence, diversifying across countries and industries becomes increasingly important for risk mitigation.

Japan’s stock market has benefited in recent years from corporate governance reforms, heightened shareholder‑pay awareness, and active efforts to improve capital efficiency, gradually attracting international capital. Compared with portfolios heavily weighted toward a few large tech firms, Japan offers a broader mix of financials, industrials, consumer, automotive and electronics sectors, providing investors with another option for overseas equity allocation.

Market participants note that investors already holding U.S. tech ETFs, Taiwan tech‑focused ETFs, or AI‑related positions can benefit from modestly adding Japanese‑stock ETFs. This not only broadens geographic exposure but also adds exposure to different industries and corporate earnings sources. When paired with dividend‑paying products, it can satisfy both overseas market participation and cash‑flow needs, enhancing portfolio flexibility.

However, investors should remember that an ETF’s dividend yield is not equivalent to its total return, and a one‑time large payout does not guarantee future consistency. When evaluating Japanese‑stock ETFs, beyond the dividend amount and annualized yield, one should also consider NAV changes, dividend sources, total return performance, currency risk, and the characteristics of the underlying index, avoiding reliance solely on high yields as an investment basis.

items.title: 十銓：記憶體缺貨尚未達高峰「到明年Q2最吃緊」 千坪新廠估增5成產能
items.title_en: TenQ: Memory Shortage Not Yet at Peak, "Tightest Until Q2 Next Year" New 1,000-Ping Factory Expected to Boost Capacity by 50%
paras: 記憶體模組廠十銓(4967-TW)今(2)日召開法說，公司表示，這波記憶體景氣循環與過去不同，主要受到產業結構改變、原廠及模組廠寡占化影響，價格已連漲一年，短期內看不到反轉跡象，且真正缺貨最嚴重的時刻還沒到，預估今年第四季至明年第二季末將是供貨最吃緊的階段，不排除出現有錢也買不到貨的情況。
十銓表示，目前全球記憶體供應主要集中在三星、美光及SK海力士，台灣及中國大陸業者雖持續擴產，但短期產量仍不足以左右整體市場供需，加上主要模組廠也逐漸寡占化，價格主導能力提高，使這波景氣循環不同於過去每兩至六個月就出現一次波動的情況，短期內價格仍有支撐。
十銓指出，第四季至明年第一季記憶體價格仍將持續上漲，部分缺貨較嚴重的產品，過去每季合約價格漲幅約30%至40%，預期漲勢仍將延續。其中，LPDDR5X隨著應用從手機擴大至新一代AI運算設備，單一設備搭載量提高，也進一步推升需求。
供貨方面，十銓與各大原廠合作近30年，透過長期交易紀錄及長期供貨協議(LTA)爭取貨源。截至第三季底，庫存金額約172億元，其中DRAM占75%、NAND Flash占25%，後續將以伺服器、工控長期訂單客戶及高階消費性產品為主要備貨方向，採取邊買邊賣策略，買得到多少就供應多少。
消費性市場方面，十銓表示，手機及一般PC在記憶體供貨分配上相對處於劣勢，PC業者已透過降低記憶體規格控制整機成本，預期明年情況仍難明顯改善，消費性模組市場可能要到2028年下半年才有機會迎來轉機。
面對記憶體市場結構轉變，十銓也同步調整營運組織，將既有業務整合為企業暨工控應用、品牌暨通路兩大事業群。其中，企業暨工控應用事業群聚焦伺服器記憶體、企業級SSD、工控及邊緣AI應用，強化產品驗證導入與技術服務；品牌暨通路事業群則運用逾20年全球品牌及通路經營經驗，鎖定高階電競、專業工作站及創作者市場，深化系統整合商(SI)與通路夥伴合作。
至於毛利率持續走高，十銓指出，除了記憶體售價上漲，也受惠於產品及客戶組合轉變，B2B營收比重已提高至約65%，逐步轉向AI伺服器、工業電腦及高技術門檻應用。由於這類客戶對價格的承受度較高，且長期訂單逐漸增加，加上庫存成本與銷售價格的時間差，有助於支撐整體獲利表現，且目前庫存操作維持健康，隨產品組合持續朝高階應用發展，對後續毛利率仍具信心。
為支援企業級及工控業務發展，十銓也在新北市新購約千坪廠房，規劃導入自動化生產設備，以因應少量多樣的產品需求。新廠預計2027年第一季展開裝修及設備進駐，第二季完工投產，屆時可增加約50%產能，並透過兩座工廠的生產調度提高製程彈性。同時，透過兩大事業群分工，深化高階消費性產品及全球通路經營，同時擴大企業級與工控應用布局，配合新廠投產增加產能，掌握記憶體市場需求及產業轉型商機。
paras_en: Memory module maker TenQ (4967-TW) held a briefing today, stating that the current memory cycle differs from the past, driven by industry structural changes and increasing concentration among OEMs and module makers. Prices have risen continuously for a year, with no short‑term reversal in sight, and the most severe shortage has not yet arrived. The company forecasts that the tightest supply period will be from Q4 this year through the end of Q2 next year, and it may even reach a point where money cannot secure inventory.

TenQ noted that global memory supply is now dominated by Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix. Although Taiwanese and mainland Chinese players are expanding capacity, their short‑term output remains insufficient to sway overall market balance. Meanwhile, the consolidation of major module manufacturers is enhancing price‑setting power, making this cycle unlike the past where fluctuations occurred every two to six months, and price support is expected to persist in the near term.

The firm expects memory prices to keep rising through Q4 and into Q1 next year. For products experiencing the sharpest shortages, contract prices have historically jumped 30‑40% each quarter, and this upward trend is expected to continue. In particular, LPDDR5X demand is being boosted as its use expands from smartphones to next‑generation AI computing devices, increasing the per‑device memory count.

On the supply side, TenQ has partnered with major OEMs for nearly 30 years, leveraging long‑term transaction records and long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to secure shipments. By the end of Q3, inventory was valued at about NT$17.2 billion, with DRAM accounting for 75% and NAND flash 25%. Going forward, the company will prioritize stocking for server, industrial‑control long‑term orders and high‑end consumer products, adopting a buy‑as‑you‑sell approach – supplying as much as it can procure.

In the consumer market, TenQ said that smartphones and typical PCs are at a disadvantage in memory allocation. PC makers have been lowering memory specifications to control system costs, and the situation is unlikely to improve noticeably next year. The consumer module market may not see a turnaround until the second half of 2028.

Facing the shift in memory market structure, TenQ is reorganizing its operations, consolidating existing sales into two business groups: Enterprise & Industrial Applications and Brand & Channel. The former focuses on server memory, enterprise‑grade SSDs, industrial control and edge AI, strengthening product validation and technical services; the latter leverages over 20 years of global brand and channel experience to target high‑end gaming, professional workstations and creator markets, deepening cooperation with system integrators and channel partners.

Regarding rising gross margins, TenQ attributed the improvement not only to higher memory prices but also to a shift in product and customer mix. B2B revenue now makes up about 65% of sales, moving toward AI servers, industrial PCs and high‑tech applications. These customers have higher price tolerance and growing long‑term orders, and the timing gap between inventory cost and sales price supports overall profitability. Inventory remains healthy, and as the product mix continues toward high‑end applications, the company remains confident about future margins.

To support its enterprise and industrial businesses, TenQ is acquiring a roughly 1,000‑ping (≈3,300 sqm) plant in New Taipei City, planning to install automated production equipment to meet low‑volume, high‑variety demand. The new factory is slated for renovation and equipment installation in Q1 2027, with completion and start‑up in Q2, boosting capacity by about 50%. Coordinated production across the two sites will enhance process flexibility, while the two business groups will deepen high‑end consumer product and global channel operations, expand enterprise and industrial application coverage, and capture memory market demand and transformation opportunities.

items.title: AI高速傳輸需求升溫 法人看好眾達-KY 400G、800G產品放量
items.title_en: AI High-Speed Transmission Demand Rises, Institutional Investors Favor Zhongda-KY’s 400G and 800G Products Scaling Up
paras: 台股光通訊廠眾達-KY (4977-TW) 受惠於雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI基礎建設投資，帶動資料中心高速傳輸需求快速升溫。隨著各大CSP對高階網路交換器的傳輸速率要求不斷提升，產業規格正加速朝400G、800G世代推進。法人預估，眾達-KY明(2027)年400G產品將持續放量，800G產品也將逐步跟上，成為推升公司營運成長的主要動能。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前市場關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，以及公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(Broadcom)的合作布局，相關發展也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
隨著AI伺服器運算規模持續擴大，資料傳輸瓶頸已成為資料中心建置的重要課題。當傳輸速率由400G邁向800G，甚至進一步朝1.6T發展，資料傳輸架構也逐漸走向光電整合、光銅並進的趨勢。其中，短距離傳輸仍以銅纜為主，以兼顧成本與功耗；中長距離及高頻寬傳輸需求，則更多仰賴光通訊技術支援，帶動高速光收發模組的滲透率持續提升，成為AI資料中心升級的重要環節。
從眾達-KY目前產品營收結構來看，400G及800G產品合計已占營收約六成。其中，法人預估400G產品營收占比約達40%至50%，800G產品則隨出貨逐步升溫，營收貢獻持續增加，未來占比可望進一步擴大，成為公司產品組合升級及營運成長的重要支柱。
法人表示，眾達-KY正積極投入矽光子相關應用技術的產品發展活動，配合公司長期合作夥伴博通的研發進度，預計順利完成客戶認證後，有望開始正式放量投產。
paras_en: Taiwan’s optical communications maker Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW) is benefiting from cloud service providers (CSPs) continuously expanding AI infrastructure investments, which is heating up demand for high‑speed data‑center transmission. As major CSPs raise the required transmission rates of high‑end network switches, industry standards are rapidly moving toward the 400G and 800G generations. Institutional investors estimate that Zhongda‑KY’s 400G products will keep ramping up in 2027, with 800G products following suit, becoming a key driver of the company’s operational growth.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules. Market attention is now centered on the shipment progress of high‑end 400G and 800G products and the company’s collaborative layout with Broadcom in laser‑optical packaging, which has become an important indicator for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

As AI server compute scales continue to expand, data‑transfer bottlenecks have become a critical issue for data‑center construction. When transmission rates move from 400G toward 800G—and eventually toward 1.6T—the data‑transfer architecture is shifting toward a hybrid of photonic integration and copper. Short‑reach transmission remains copper‑cable‑dominant to balance cost and power consumption, while mid‑ to long‑reach, high‑bandwidth needs rely increasingly on optical‑communication technology, driving higher penetration of high‑speed optical transceiver modules and becoming a vital link in AI data‑center upgrades.

Looking at Zhongda‑KY’s current product revenue mix, 400G and 800G products together already account for about 60% of revenue. Institutional investors estimate that 400G contributes roughly 40%–50% of revenue, while 800G’s share is rising as shipments heat up, with its contribution expected to grow further and become a major pillar of the company’s product portfolio upgrade and operational growth.

Institutions note that Zhongda‑KY is actively investing in silicon‑photonics‑related application technologies, aligning with its long‑term partner Broadcom’s R&D timeline. After successful customer certification, the company expects to commence full‑scale production and volume ramp‑up.

items.title: 台積電供應鏈迅得對半導體設備出貨走揚 10月營收改寫歷史次高
items.title_en: TSMC Supply Chain's Shunde Sees Semiconductor Equipment Shipments Rise, October Revenue Rewrites Historic Second‑Highest
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈設備大廠迅得(6438-TW)營收在半導體業務推進一如預期，10 月營收維持在 6 億元以上高檔，今(2)日揭露以 6.73億元改寫歷史單月次高，也創同期新高，月減3.15%、年增28.08%；累計 2026 年 1-10 月營收達61.86億元，年增 10.93%。
迅得 2026 年第三季營收達 19.45 億元，季增 6.64%、年增 13.62%，單季營收刷新歷史紀錄。法人預估，第四季營收將可維持在此一歷史高檔水準之上。
迅得投資 1.5 億元取得南科友上科技 23% 股權後，公司高層透露，目前仍有其他投資案持續推進中。同時，為因應持續湧入的設備訂單，迅得最快將於今年底至明年初在台灣南部取得土地興建新廠，全面提升產能供給。
在營運效益方面，迅得營運總部遷入新生廠後產能已達滿載，進一步推升獲利表現。2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，毛利率 26.13%，稅後純益 3.11 億元，每股純益(EPS)達 3.79 元。2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創高，稅後純益 1.66 億元，優於首季的 1.45 億元，單季 EPS 為 2.03 元。
隨著迅得安排出貨的半導體設備於第四季步入出貨高峰，加上產品組合優化，下半年營運將顯著優於上半年。法人預估，迅得 2026 全年營收將較 2025 年的 64.67 億元成長 10%–15%，續創歷史新高；在產品組合有利因素加持下，獲利成長幅度更有望達到營收增幅的倍數呈現。
迅得同時具備半導體與 PCB 設備雙重成長動能，在 PCB 領域，公司鎖定高階載板與板廠需求，目前已握有臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及景碩(3189-TW)等大廠確立訂單。
paras_en: Shunde (6438‑TW), a major equipment supplier in TSMC's supply chain, saw semiconductor business advance as expected, with October revenue staying above NT$600 million. Today (2nd) it disclosed NT$673 million, rewriting the historic single‑month second‑highest and setting a new high for the period, down 3.15% month‑over‑month, up 28.08% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for Jan‑Oct 2026 reached NT$6.186 billion, up 10.93% YoY.
Shunde's Q3 2026 revenue hit NT$1.945 billion, up 6.64% sequentially and 13.62% YoY, a quarterly record. Analysts estimate Q4 revenue will stay above this historic high level.

After investing NT$150 million to acquire a 23% stake in Youshang Technology of the Southern Science Park, management said other investment projects are still progressing. To cope with the influx of equipment orders, Shunde plans to acquire land in southern Taiwan by year‑end to early next year to build a new plant, fully boosting capacity.

On the operational side, after moving its headquarters to the new plant, capacity is now fully utilized, further improving profitability. H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% YoY, gross margin 26.13%, net profit NT$311 million, EPS NT$3.79. Q2 2026 revenue reached a record NT$1.824 billion, net profit NT$166 million, higher than Q1’s NT$145 million, with quarterly EPS of NT$2.03.

With Shunde’s semiconductor equipment shipments entering a peak in Q4 and product‑mix optimization, H2 performance is expected to be markedly better than H1. Analysts project 2026 full‑year revenue to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, setting a new historic high; profit growth could outpace revenue growth, potentially multiples of the revenue increase.

Shunde also has dual growth drivers in semiconductor and PCB equipment. In the PCB segment, the company targets high‑end substrates and fab demand, and has already secured orders from major players such as Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW).

items.title: 00980A受益人數暴增近130% 年化配息率12%
items.title_en: 00980A Beneficiary Numbers Surge Nearly 130% Annual Yield 12%
paras: 外資在上月賣超台股9,943.17億元，創下歷史最高單月賣超紀錄。台股從月初光輝十月行情，一度衝上49,968.92點，距五萬點大關僅一步之遙，隨後卻在高利率、AI投資回收疑慮與外資賣壓交織下震盪走低，並於最後一個交易日跌破半年線成悲傷十月，美股更是慘遭血血洗。面對劇烈波動，主動野村台灣優選（00980A-TW）受益人數年增近130%，今(2) 日公布第一階段收益分配公告，每單位擬配發0.688元，按今日收盤價22.79元換算，單次配息率為3.02%，年化配息率為12.08%。
00980A本次除息交易日為11月17日，最後買進日為11月16日，收益分配預計於12月11日發放。
觀察2020年以來不含本次之十大外資賣超月份，平均單月賣超金額達4,655.27億元，加權指數當月平均下跌4.95%；但若將時間拉長至六個月，加權指數則平均上漲17.48%。野村投信表示，外資集中賣超雖可能加重短期市場壓力，中期行情仍須回歸企業獲利與產業趨勢觀察，投資人可在震盪中檢視基本面，評估分批布局機會。
00980A基金經理人游景德表示，今年台股較大幅度的震盪集中在4月、7月與10月，適逢季報公布與美國大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）擴大資本支出的時點，反映市場對AI融資成本與投資延續性的關注。不過，最新科技巨頭財報顯示，雲端與AI需求仍持續成長，五大CSP明年資本支出預估上修至1.3兆美元，AI基礎建設投資循環尚未見頂。
游景德指出，野村投信內部股票池預估，2026年企業每股盈餘年增率已上修至80.3%，連續10個月上修；新一代AI平台Vera Rubin於今年第四季末至明年第一季初進入量產，可望帶動相關供應鏈營收成長。儘管個別公司訂單與產品規格調整的消息可能影響市場情緒，台灣廠商在伺服器滑軌、ABF載板及散熱等領域的競爭優勢仍具支撐，投資人可透過定期定額分散進場時點，依資金規劃逢低分批加碼。
00980A採季配息機制，成立於2025年4月22日，為台股首檔主動式ETF，受益人數已達71,476人，較去年同期成長129.68%。
paras_en: Foreign investors sold Taiwanese stocks worth NT$9,943.17 billion last month, setting a record for the highest single‑month net sell‑off. The market, which had risen to 49,968.92 points early in the month and was just a step away from the 50,000‑point milestone, later slipped amid high interest rates, concerns over AI investment returns and foreign‑investor selling pressure, breaking below the six‑month moving average on the final trading day and delivering a sad October, while U.S. stocks suffered a brutal sell‑off. Amid the volatility, Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW) saw its beneficiary count rise by almost 130% year‑over‑year and today (the 2nd) announced the first‑stage dividend distribution, proposing a payout of NT$0.688 per unit, which translates to a one‑time yield of 3.02% based on today’s closing price of NT$22.79 and an annualised yield of 12.08%.
The ex‑dividend date for 00980A is November 17, the last purchase day is November 16, and the dividend distribution is scheduled for December 11.

Looking at the ten months with the largest foreign‑investor net sell‑offs since 2020 (excluding the current one), the average monthly net sell‑off was NT$4,655.27 billion and the weighted index fell an average of 4.95% that month; however, over a six‑month horizon the index rose an average of 17.48%. Nomura Asset Management says that while concentrated foreign selling may increase short‑term pressure, the medium‑term market will revert to fundamentals such as corporate earnings and industry trends, and investors can use the volatility to assess fundamentals and evaluate opportunities for staggered positioning.

Fund manager You Jing‑de of 00980A noted that this year’s major swings in the Taiwan market were concentrated in April, July and October, coinciding with quarterly earnings releases and the timing of increased capital expenditures by major U.S. cloud service providers (CSPs), reflecting market focus on AI financing costs and investment continuity. Nevertheless, the latest earnings from tech giants show that cloud and AI demand remain robust, with the five largest CSPs revising next‑year cap‑ex forecasts up to $1.3 trillion, indicating the AI infrastructure investment cycle has not peaked yet.

You Jing‑de added that Nomura’s internal stock pool now projects the 2026 corporate earnings per share growth rate up to 80.3%, a revision sustained for ten consecutive months. The next‑generation AI platform Vera Rubin is expected to enter mass production from late Q4 this year into early Q1 next year, which should boost revenue for related supply‑chain firms. Although news of order changes or product specifications at individual companies may sway sentiment, Taiwanese manufacturers retain competitive advantages in server rails, ABF substrates and cooling solutions, supporting the sector. Investors can adopt a regular‑interval, dollar‑cost‑averaging approach to add positions on dips according to their capital plans.

00980A employs a quarterly dividend policy, was launched on April 22 2025, and is Taiwan’s first actively managed ETF. Its beneficiary count has reached 71,476, up 129.68% from the same period last year.

items.title: 耐特預計11/19掛牌上市 11/4競拍起跑底價62.5元
items.title_en: Naiter Plans November 19 Listing; Auction Starts November 4 with Base Price of NT$62.5
paras: 高性能複合材料廠耐特(8058-TW)配合上市前公開承銷，對外競價拍賣4896張，競拍底價62.5元，最高投標張數612張，暫定每股承銷價80元。競拍時間為11月4日至6日，11月10日開標；11月9日至11日辦理公開申購，11月13日抽籤，預計11月19日掛牌。
耐特近三年營收規模持續成長，2023年至2025年合併營收分別為21.01億元、23.7億元及24.68億元，每股純益分別為1.06元、2.27元及1.95元。2026年上半年營收14.21億元、毛利4.19億元，毛利率約29%、營業利益率約11%、每股純益達1.85元。
從營收結構來看，半導體與BBU相關用料占比已從2023年的3.59%，提升至2024年的11.09%、2025年的20.94%，2026年上半年進一步達25.76%。其中，半導體用料占比已接近兩成；BBU材料則受惠AI伺服器及資料中心對備援電力安全性要求提高，持續朝高耐熱、阻燃及絕緣等高規格應用發展，顯示兩大高階材料業務已逐步從新興布局轉為實質營收來源。
為因應高階材料需求，耐特於2024年至2026年間陸續增設半導體專用潔淨產線及IC Tray專線。目前彰化廠共有13條產線，包括2條半導體專線及2條IC Tray專線；上海廠則有7條產線，其中2條為半導體專線，兩地合計20條產線。隨著客戶認證逐步完成、量產規模擴大，2026年上半年產能利用率已回升至70%，顯示前期擴產效益逐漸顯現。
在半導體材料方面，耐特中高階晶圓載具及光罩盒相關材料已通過客戶認證並穩定量產，中低階載具材料也已進入量產供貨階段。雖然目前相關載具占整體營收比重仍低於5%，但透過既有量產實績及終端客戶驗證經驗，公司已逐步累積高潔淨、低釋氣、抗靜電及尺寸穩定等關鍵材料技術能力，為後續拓展高階半導體應用奠定基礎。
此外，IC Tray也是耐特積極拓展的高階應用市場。由於IC載盤材料須具備穩定的抗靜電性能，以避免靜電對晶片造成影響，耐特已導入潔淨製程，並透過配方技術提升抗靜電效果的均勻性，同時開發可耐150°C高溫的載盤材料。目前相關材料已進入量產供貨階段，後續將配合國際客戶成品驗證及導入進度，逐步擴大應用範圍。

根據Grand View Research研究，全球塑膠複合材料市場規模預估將由2024年的805億美元，成長至2030年的1,082億美元，年複合成長率約5%。隨著AI運算、半導體先進製程及高功率電子設備持續升級，對高性能複合材料的需求也同步增加。耐特表示，未來將持續聚焦半導體載具、IC Tray及BBU三大高附加價值應用，結合客製化配方研發、潔淨製程及既有量產實績，進一步強化產品競爭力與營運成長動能。
paras_en: Naiter (8058‑TW), a high‑performance composite materials manufacturer, is conducting a pre‑IPO public underwriting auction of 4,896 shares at a base price of NT$62.5, with the highest bid quantity of 612 shares and a provisional underwriting price of NT$80 per share. The auction runs from November 4 to 6, with the opening bid on November 10; public subscription is from November 9 to 11, the lottery on November 13, and the listing is expected on November 19.

Over the past three years Naiter’s revenue has continuously grown, with consolidated revenue of NT$2.101 billion, NT$2.37 billion and NT$2.468 billion for 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively, and earnings per share of NT$1.06, NT$2.27 and NT$1.95. In the first half of 2026 revenue reached NT$1.421 billion, gross profit NT$419 million (gross margin about 29%), operating profit margin about 11%, and EPS of NT$1.85.

From a revenue‑mix perspective, semiconductor‑related and BBU‑related materials rose from 3.59% of total revenue in 2023 to 11.09% in 2024, 20.94% in 2025 and further to 25.76% in the first half of 2026. Semiconductor materials now account for nearly 20% of sales; BBU materials benefit from higher safety requirements for power redundancy in AI servers and data centers, driving development toward high‑heat‑resistance, flame‑retardant and insulating specifications, indicating that these two high‑end material lines are shifting from emerging projects to substantive revenue sources.

To meet demand for high‑end materials, Naiter has added dedicated semiconductor clean lines and IC‑Tray lines between 2024 and 2026. The Changhua plant now has 13 production lines, including two semiconductor lines and two IC‑Tray lines; the Shanghai plant has seven lines, two of which are semiconductor lines, for a total of 20 lines across both sites. With customer certifications progressing and mass‑production volumes expanding, capacity utilization rose to 70% in the first half of 2026, showing the early benefits of the expansion are materializing.

In semiconductor materials, Naiter’s mid‑to‑high‑end wafer carriers and photomask box materials have passed customer certification and are in stable mass production, while low‑to‑mid‑end carrier materials have entered volume supply. Although carrier materials currently represent less than 5% of total revenue, the company has gradually built key capabilities—high cleanliness, low outgassing, antistatic performance and dimensional stability—through existing production records and end‑customer validation, laying a foundation for future high‑end semiconductor applications.

IC‑Tray is also a focus for Naiter’s high‑end market expansion. Because IC‑Tray materials must provide stable antistatic performance to protect chips from static discharge, Naiter has introduced clean‑process manufacturing and formulation technology to improve the uniformity of antistatic effects, and has developed tray material that can withstand 150 °C. These materials are now in volume supply and will be further expanded as international customers complete product verification and adoption.

According to Grand View Research, the global plastic composite materials market is projected to grow from US$80.5 billion in 2024 to US$108.2 billion by 2030, at a compound annual growth rate of about 5%. As AI computing, advanced semiconductor processes and high‑power electronic equipment continue to evolve, demand for high‑performance composites rises in tandem. Naiter says it will keep focusing on three high‑value‑add applications—semiconductor carriers, IC‑Trays and BBU—leveraging customized formulation R&D, clean‑process manufacturing and existing mass‑production experience to further strengthen product competitiveness and growth momentum.

items.title: 大同華映案和解露曙光 有望回沖近百億元損失 估每股稅前盈餘貢獻4.6元
items.title_en: Da Tong Hua Ying Settlement Shows Promise, May Recover Nearly NT$100 Billion Loss, Estimated Pre‑Tax EPS Contribution NT$4.6
paras: 大同(2371-TW)纏訟多年的中國華映案露和解曙光，公司今(2)日召開重訊記者會，指出雙方歷經協商並各自召開董事會，決議通過以人民幣7.68億元(約新台幣37.56億元)的和解金條件為目標，若後續簽署和解文件，有望回沖近百億元的損失，每股稅前盈餘有望貢獻4.6元。
中國最高人民法院於2025年底判決，針對華映案，大同須負連帶清償責任，判賠人民幣30.29億元(約新台幣135億元)。而大同已於去年第四季全數一次性認列損失135.67億元，如和解條件確定，將可提列金額迴轉。
大同指出，自結至今年第三季，針對華映案帳列剩餘負債約人民幣28.03億元(約新台幣137.1億元)，若以人民幣7.68億元(約新台幣37.56億元)和解金條件計算，相較原判決30.29億元的補償款，判賠金額將減少74.6%，預計可回沖利益約人民幣20.35億元(約新台幣99.54億元)。
大同表示，以目前約21.51億股普通股估算，回沖利益相當於每股約可貢獻4.6元的稅前純益。公司並強調，實際回沖金額、認列時程以及每股純益影響仍須視所得稅及會計認列結果而定。
paras_en: Da Tong (2371‑TW) has seen a glimmer of hope in the long‑running China Hua Ying case. The company held a major press conference today, stating that after negotiations and board approvals on both sides, they have agreed to target a settlement amount of RMB 768 million (about NT$3.756 billion). If the settlement agreement is signed, the company could recoup nearly NT$100 billion of losses, contributing about NT$4.6 to pre‑tax earnings per share.

The Supreme People’s Court of China ruled at the end of 2025 that Da Tong bears joint and several liability for the Hua Ying case, ordering a compensation of RMB 3.029 billion (approximately NT$13.5 billion). Da Tong had already recorded a one‑time loss of NT$13.567 billion in the fourth quarter of last year. If the settlement terms are confirmed, that amount can be reversed.

Da Tong noted that up to the third quarter of this year, the remaining liability recorded for the Hua Ying case was about RMB 2.803 billion (around NT$13.71 billion). Using the proposed settlement figure of RMB 768 million (about NT$3.756 billion) would reduce the compensation by 74.6% compared with the original court‑ordered RMB 3.029 billion, allowing an estimated profit reversal of roughly RMB 2.035 billion (about NT$9.954 billion).

Based on approximately 2.151 billion ordinary shares outstanding, the profit reversal translates to an estimated pre‑tax profit contribution of about NT$4.6 per share. The company cautioned that the actual reversal amount, timing of recognition, and per‑share profit impact will depend on income‑tax and accounting treatment outcomes.

items.title: 1150億美元押注AI！邁威爾收購Lumentum 挑戰博通
items.title_en: $115 Billion Bet on AI! Marvell to Acquire Lumentum, Challenging Broadcom
paras: 客製化晶片大廠邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周一(2日)宣布，將以全股票交易收購光通訊元件製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)，含債務在內的交易總值達1,150億美元，為今年規模最大的併購案之一。邁威爾押注，科技巨頭持續擴建AI資料中心，連接晶片所需的高速光通訊元件將持續供不應求。這筆交易也將擴充邁威爾的產品線，使其更有本錢與博通(AVGO-US)爭奪訂單。
依協議，Lumentum每股換股對價為1,132美元，較10月28日併購消息曝光前的收盤價溢價23.9%，股權交易價值為1,025.4億美元。邁威爾估計，合併後雙方產品可觸及的市場規模將擴大至5,500億美元。周一美股盤前，邁威爾上漲2.8%，Lumentum則暫停交易。

從客製化晶片到高速光通訊 邁威爾擴大挑戰博通

邁威爾近年協助亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等科技巨頭開發客製化AI晶片與資料中心網路技術，市值已突破1,700億美元。相較之下，博通長期擔任Google的主要客製化晶片合作夥伴，還能一次供應多種AI資料中心硬體。Lumentum的規模約為邁威爾的一半，收購後，邁威爾除了能替客戶設計晶片，也能供應讓資料在晶片之間高速傳輸的光通訊元件。
邁威爾今年8月已打入Google供應鏈，簽約供應與Google自研AI處理器搭配使用的晶片。這項協議到2033會計年度為止，最高可為邁威爾帶來1,200億美元銷售額，Google也取得買進價值122億美元邁威爾股份的權利。Google母公司為Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)。
輝達(NVDA-US)今年稍早也分別向邁威爾和Lumentum各投資20億美元。輝達執行長黃仁勳6月點名邁威爾有望成為下一家市值突破1兆美元的企業，帶動其股價創新高。邁威爾全年營收已從2021會計年度的30億美元，增至2026會計年度的82億美元。

美國擬限中國光收發模組 Lumentum有望受惠

AI代理與聊天機器人應用增加，資料中心內數千顆晶片需要更快的光通訊連線。邁威爾今年2月才以35億美元完成收購Celestial AI，擴充光子技術業務。此次收購Lumentum，則是邁威爾自2021年以100億美元買下Inphi以來，規模最大的一筆交易。
Lumentum的競爭對手包括美國光通訊廠Coherent(COHR-US)及中國的中際旭創(300308-CN)。美國正研議禁止新的中國製光收發模組進入市場，若提案實施，部分需求可能轉向美國供應商，Lumentum也有望受惠。
自雙方洽談併購的消息於上月底曝光以來，Lumentum股價已下跌約8%，邁威爾則下跌約22%。這段期間，英特爾(INTC-US)財測疲弱，加劇晶片股的全面賣壓。
paras_en: Marvell Technology (MRVL-US), a major custom‑chip maker, announced on Monday (the 2nd) that it will acquire optical‑components manufacturer Lumentum (LITE-US) in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion including debt, making it one of the largest mergers of the year. Marvell is betting that tech giants will keep expanding AI data centers, creating sustained shortage for the high‑speed optical components needed to connect chips. The deal will also broaden Marvell’s product line, giving it more firepower to compete with Broadcom (AVGO-US) for orders.

Under the agreement, Lumentum’s share‑exchange price is $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium to its closing price before the acquisition news broke on Oct. 28, valuing the equity portion at $102.54 billion. Marvell estimates that the combined product portfolio will address a market of $550 billion after the merger. In pre‑market trading on Monday, Marvell rose 2.8% while Lumentum’s shares were halted.

From custom chips to high‑speed optics, Marvell expands its challenge to Broadcom. In recent years Marvell has helped tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN-US) develop custom AI chips and data‑center networking technology, pushing its market cap past $170 billion. By contrast, Broadcom has long been Google’s primary custom‑chip partner and can supply a range of AI data‑center hardware in one go. Lumentum is roughly half the size of Marvell, and after the acquisition Marvell will not only design chips for customers but also provide the optical components that enable ultra‑fast data transfer between chips.

Marvell entered Google’s supply chain in August, signing a contract to provide chips that work with Google’s in‑house AI processor. The agreement runs through fiscal 2033 and could generate up to $120 billion in sales for Marvell, while Google secures the right to purchase $12.2 billion worth of Marvell stock. Google’s parent is Alphabet (GOOGL-US, GOOG-US).

Earlier this year Nvidia (NVDA-US) invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang singled out Marvell in June as a candidate to become the next trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap company, sending its stock to new highs. Marvell’s annual revenue has grown from $3 billion in fiscal 2021 to $8.2 billion in fiscal 2026.

The U.S. is poised to limit Chinese optical transceiver modules, which could benefit Lumentum. Growing AI agents and chat‑bot usage mean thousands of chips in data centers need faster optical links. In February Marvell completed a $3.5 billion acquisition of Celestial AI to expand its photonics business. The Lumentum deal is Marvell’s largest since it bought Inphi for $10 billion in 2021.

Lumentum’s rivals include U.S. optics firm Coherent (COHR-US) and China’s Zhongji Xuchuang (300308-CN). The U.S. is considering a ban on new Chinese‑made optical transceiver modules entering the market; if enacted, some demand could shift to U.S. suppliers, potentially benefiting Lumentum.

Since the merger talks were disclosed at the end of last month, Lumentum’s share price has fallen about 8% and Marvell’s about 22%. During that period, Intel’s (INTC-US) weak guidance added to broad selling pressure on chip stocks.

items.title: 大量新興雲端業者將在1到3年內破產？Bernstein警告：商業模式存在「致命」風險
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資熱潮持續延燒，但新興雲端業者（Neocloud）可能正面臨一場尚未浮現的財務危機。Bernstein最新研究報告引述資料中心法律專家Jeffrey Moerdler的分析指出，Neocloud業者普遍存在長短期租約錯配問題，部分企業恐在未來1至3年內陸續破產，情況可能重演共享辦公室業者WeWork的崩潰模式。
Moerdler自1990年起專注於資料中心及數位基礎設施法律業務，目前帶領約10名律師的團隊，每年處理數百筆交易，同時經手約30至40個專案。
他直言，Neocloud的商業模式令人擔憂，形同「WeWork 2.0」。
問題在於，Neocloud業者通常簽訂長達15年的資料中心租約，但向客戶提供的算力服務合約卻短得多，可能只有幾天、幾週或幾個月，即使較長的合約也通常僅有1至3年。
一旦客戶不再續約，業者收入便可能中斷，卻仍須持續承擔長期租金與設施成本。
Moerdler預期，未來1至3年將有部分Neocloud業者陷入破產困境，尤其是規模較小、專注特定垂直產業的AI新創公司，例如專門服務律師事務所或服飾產業的業者，若無法創造足夠收入，將難以維持營運。

資料中心擔保從全額縮水至80% 開發商風險升高

除了租約期限錯配，資料中心融資與租賃合約中的信用擔保結構也正在改變，進一步增加開發商的財務風險。
Moerdler指出，約10個月前，一家超大型雲端服務商率先改變市場慣例，不再提供涵蓋全部租約義務的信用擔保，而是僅承諾擔保約80%的建設貸款。
換言之，超出貸款保障範圍的建設成本，以及其餘20%的貸款風險，都必須由開發商自行承擔。
更值得注意的是，這類擔保通常會在租約初始期間採直線法逐年攤銷。以10年期租約為例，到了第7年或第8年，原有擔保價值幾乎已經耗盡。
與此同時，擔保方也開始要求更廣泛的介入權（Step-in Rights），也就是在需要履行擔保義務時，能夠直接接管相關資料中心空間及電力資源。過去這類安排通常由擔保方與客戶私下協商，如今則逐漸納入正式租約條款。
Moerdler表示，過去10至12個月，他經手涉及超大型雲端業者、AI公司及晶片製造商信用增強的交易，無一例外都已從全額租約擔保轉向有限度擔保。
資料中心合約暗藏四大風險 開發商恐失去資產控制權
Moerdler也提醒，資料中心租約中有多項容易被忽略的條款，可能在日後造成重大損失。
首先是「隨意終止權」（Termination-for-Convenience），允許租戶在特定條件下，無須提出特定違約事由便可終止合約。這類條款經常出現在超大型雲端業者的標準合約中，卻可能讓開發商在投入大量建設成本後，仍面臨租約提前終止的風險。
其次是信用擔保額度不足或攤銷速度過快，導致租約進入後期時，開發商原本仰賴的信用保障已大幅減弱。
第三，租約轉讓也可能使原有信用保護失效。如果租戶將租約轉讓給第三方，卻未能同步保留原本的信用增強安排，開發商便可能失去重要的風險緩衝。
第四則是租戶取得過多園區控制權，包括擴張權、縮減權，以及限制開發商開發相鄰土地的權利，可能進一步削弱開發商對自有資產的處置彈性。
Moerdler分享一個案例指出，曾有客戶委託他審查一份Neocloud租約，他在一個週末內便提出約50項修改意見，並建議若對方不願接受其中四分之三的修改，就不應進行交易。
最終，Neocloud僅願意修改約10%至20%的條款，客戶因此決定放棄簽約。

Neocloud倒閉未必是壞事 關鍵在開發商能否收回設施

不過，Neocloud破產對資料中心開發商而言，也未必完全是負面結果。
Moerdler認為，如果開發商事先建立足夠的信用保障，在租戶倒閉後順利收回設施，反而可能取得成本更具競爭力的資料中心資產。
他以每兆瓦建設成本1,000萬美元為例，假設開發商事先取得相當於建設成本30%的信用增強保障，包括信用狀、現金保證金、預付款或投資級企業擔保，那麼即使Neocloud破產，開發商收回設施後，實際成本基礎便可降至每兆瓦700萬美元。
由於資料中心已經完工，開發商可以重新出租設施，並以低於其他每兆瓦建設成本超過1,000萬美元的競爭者的價格進入市場。
但這項策略有一個重要前提，就是開發商必須能夠迅速收回資產。Moerdler指出，在紐約等地，收回不動產可能耗時1至2年，期間將大幅削弱這種成本優勢。

電力取得時間成選址關鍵 超過48個月吸引力大減

隨著AI資料中心需求快速成長，資料中心選址的評估標準也出現轉變。Moerdler認為，過去業界重視地理位置，如今能否及時取得電力，才是決定資產價值的關鍵。
他將資料中心電力供應時程分為四個等級：12個月內可取得電力屬於最高級的「白金資產」；12至24個月為「黃金資產」；24至48個月為「白銀資產」；若等待時間超過48個月，商業吸引力便大幅下降。
舉例而言，一座規劃容量400兆瓦的資料中心園區，即使短期內只能取得100兆瓦電力，只要能在12至24個月內交付，且後續供電計畫具有可信度，仍具有相當高的投資價值。
他也指出，德州電力可靠度委員會（ERCOT）目前收到的待審電力申請量，已達德州電網現有容量的4倍，其中包含大量投機性申請。電力監管機構正透過押金及保證金要求，淘汰缺乏客戶、專業能力與資金支持的投機業者。

AI資料中心需求未降溫 城市型推理設施成新商機

儘管市場對AI基礎建設投資能否持續抱持疑慮，Moerdler根據目前經手的交易指出，資料中心需求仍呈現快速成長，尚未出現放緩跡象。
他透露，目前正在處理的專案包括德州一座3吉瓦（GW）資料中心園區，以及一筆出售德州Batch Zero資料中心園區的交易，規模超過2吉瓦，交易金額約20億美元。
不過，市場參與者對投機性交易的風險意識也明顯提高，承銷與融資標準正逐步趨嚴。
展望未來3至5年，Moerdler預期，隨著大型AI模型訓練需求逐漸趨於飽和，市場將有更多需求轉向城市及近郊的小型AI推理節點。
他指出，過去幾年資料中心產業經歷大量併購，中型營運商數量大幅減少，導致250千瓦至2兆瓦規模的在地資料中心供給不足，相關租賃價格過去兩年已上漲50%至100%。
Moerdler並透露，近期已在紐約市區完成一筆2兆瓦資料中心租約，承租方是一家AI推理設施業者。這也反映出，在大型AI訓練設施持續擴張之際，鄰近城市的小型推理運算基礎設施，正逐漸成為資料中心市場的新成長機會。

items.title: 快訊／Marvell正式宣布1,150億美元收購Lumentum 擴大AI光通訊布局
items.title_en: Breaking News: Marvell Announces $115 B Acquisition of Lumentum to Expand AI Optical Communications Portfolio
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI資料中心規模持續擴大，高速光通訊逐漸成為繼運算晶片、記憶體之後的另一項關鍵技術。美國客製化AI晶片大廠邁威爾Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)宣布，將以全股票交易方式收購光通訊元件供應商Lumentum(LITE-US)，交易企業價值達1,150億美元，為2026年規模最大的併購案之一。華爾街分析師普遍認同這項交易的戰略價值，但也擔心收購價格過高及股權稀釋壓力。
根據協議，Marvell將以每股1,132美元的股票對價收購Lumentum，較10月28日傳出併購消息前的收盤價溢價23.9%，股權價值約1,025億美元，包含債務後的企業價值為1,150億美元。Marvell預估，合併後公司的潛在市場規模將擴大至5,500億美元，進一步強化與博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)在AI資料中心市場的競爭能力。
這項交易的核心在於掌握AI資料中心快速成長的光互連需求。Marvell主要提供客製化AI晶片、網路晶片及光通訊訊號處理技術，Lumentum則供應雷射與光學元件。隨著AI運算叢集規模擴大，晶片之間的資料傳輸頻寬與功耗逐漸成為效能瓶頸。Piper Sandler認為，Lumentum的高功率雷射技術是下一代AI網路的重要環節，而整合雙方技術有助於Marvell擴大產品布局。

供應鏈控制也是收購的重要考量。Lumentum部分AI光通訊產品產能已被預訂至2029年初，顯示市場需求仍相當強勁。Marvell今年2月才完成以35億美元收購光互連技術公司Celestial AI，此次再將原本的雷射元件供應商納入旗下，可進一步掌握關鍵光學元件供應能力。輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)今年也已分別向Marvell及Lumentum投資20億美元，反映AI晶片與光通訊供應鏈的整合趨勢。
不過，市場對高額收購成本仍有疑慮。Bernstein認為交易方向符合Marvell的長期策略，但綜效尚不明確；Morningstar則擔心，Lumentum股價此前已大幅上漲，收購溢價可能使Marvell付出過高代價。Rosenblatt估計，交易可能使Marvell 2028年與2029年每股盈餘分別受到5.0%及2.4%的稀釋影響。
市場反應也顯示投資人對交易價格有所保留。自10月底傳出併購談判消息後，Marvell股價累計下跌約22%，Lumentum也回落約8%。不過，Piper Sandler仍維持Marvell「加碼」評等及400美元目標價，看好光通訊需求長期成長。

Marvell近年受惠大型科技公司擴大客製化AI晶片投資，2026會計年度營收達82億美元，較2021會計年度的30億美元增加逾一倍。今年8月，公司更取得Google AI處理器周邊晶片供應合約，至2033會計年度的潛在銷售額最高達1,200億美元。此次收購Lumentum將使Marvell從AI晶片及網路技術進一步延伸至光學元件製造，但在交易規模大幅提高後，如何將光通訊需求成長轉化為足以支撐收購成本的獲利，將成為市場後續觀察重點。

paras_en: Nov 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers continue to grow, high‑speed optical communications are becoming a key technology alongside compute chips and memory. U.S. custom AI‑chip giant Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) announced it will acquire optical‑components supplier Lumentum (LITE‑US) in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion, making it one of the largest M&A transactions of 2026. Wall Street analysts broadly endorse the strategic rationale but warn the purchase price may be high and could dilute equity.

Under the agreement, Marvell will pay $1,132 per share in stock, a 23.9% premium to Lumentum’s closing price before the merger rumors surfaced on Oct. 28. The equity value is about $102.5 billion, and the enterprise value, including debt, totals $115 billion. Marvell estimates the combined company’s addressable market could expand to $550 billion, strengthening its competitive position against Broadcom (AVGO‑US) in the AI data‑center market.

The deal centers on capturing the fast‑growing demand for optical interconnects in AI data centers. Marvell provides custom AI chips, networking silicon and optical‑signal processing, while Lumentum supplies lasers and optical components. As AI compute clusters scale, bandwidth and power consumption between chips become performance bottlenecks. Piper Sandler says Lumentum’s high‑power laser technology is a critical piece of next‑generation AI networking, and integrating the two firms’ technologies will broaden Marvell’s product portfolio.

Supply‑chain control is another key motive. Capacity for some of Lumentum’s AI optical‑communication products is already booked through early 2029, indicating strong demand. Marvell completed a $3.5 billion acquisition of optical‑interconnect firm Celestial AI in February, and adding the laser‑component supplier further secures critical optical‑component supply. NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) has also invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum this year, reflecting a trend toward integrating AI‑chip and optical‑communication supply chains.

However, the market remains uneasy about the high purchase price. Bernstein says the transaction aligns with Marvell’s long‑term strategy but the synergies are unclear; Morningstar worries that Lumentum’s share price has already surged, making the premium potentially excessive. Rosenblatt estimates the deal could dilute Marvell’s 2028 and 2029 earnings per share by about 5.0% and 2.4%, respectively.

Investor reaction shows price concerns. Since the merger talks emerged at the end of October, Marvell’s stock has fallen roughly 22% and Lumentum’s about 8%. Nonetheless, Piper Sandler maintains a “Buy” rating on Marvell with a $400 price target, citing long‑term growth in optical‑communication demand.

Marvell has benefited in recent years from large tech firms expanding custom AI‑chip investments, reporting FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion, more than double the $3.0 billion in FY2021. In August, the company secured a Google AI‑processor peripheral‑chip supply contract that could generate up to $120 billion in sales through FY2033. The Lumentum acquisition will extend Marvell from AI chips and networking into optical‑component manufacturing, but the market will watch how the firm converts growing optical‑communication demand into profits sufficient to justify the sizable purchase price.
