items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉國會若換手哪些美股受影響？一次看懂軍工、醫療、加密貨幣與AI
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Which U.S. Stocks Could Be Affected by a Congressional Shift? A Quick Guide to Defense, Healthcare, Crypto and AI
paras: 洛克希德馬丁(LMT-US)約七成營收來自美國政府，但未來十年供應850架F-35戰機的計畫，仍須國會批准並撥款。這也是華爾街關注本周期中選舉的原因：若民主黨拿下參眾兩院任一院，就能在預算談判中爭取讓步，並取得委員會調查權。從軍工廠能拿到多少訂單、健保業者能保住多少收入，到AI資料中心該由誰負擔電網升級費用，都可能受到影響。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)統計，在共和黨總統執政期間，若期中選舉後兩黨分掌參眾兩院，標普500指數在選後一年平均上漲23%；若民主黨掌控兩院，平均漲幅為16%。不過，該行美國公共政策研究主管Ariana Salvatore認為，這次未必會重演歷史走勢。即使民主黨取得國會多數，總統川普仍握有否決權，在關稅及聯邦監管上也保有相當大的裁量空間。

軍工看訂單 醫療看給付

白宮已為2027會計年度提出1.5兆美元國防預算要求，另為2026會計年度尋求876億美元追加撥款，主要用於與伊朗相關的軍事行動。若民主黨在國會取得優勢，可能檢視部分涉及伊朗及以色列的支出，同時爭取增加對烏克蘭的援助。相較之下，嚇阻中國、核武現代化及飛彈防禦都有跨黨派支持。以洛克希德馬丁為例，該公司與五角大廈簽的是F-35採購框架協議，國會是否授權多年期採購並編列經費，才決定這批戰機能否成為正式訂單。

醫療業對聯邦預算同樣敏感。健康政策研究機構KFF根據國會預算處估算，川普去年簽署的減稅與支出法案，到2034年將使聯邦醫療補助計畫(Medicaid)支出累計減少9,110億美元。健康保險商Molina Healthcare(MOH-US)去年有322億美元保費收入來自Medicaid，占其保費收入的75%。民主黨即使只拿下一院，也能在預算談判中爭取延後部分刪減，協助保險商維持投保人數，並減輕醫院照護無保險病患的負擔。但同一批議員也可能加強檢視保費、藥價與業者獲利，醫療股受到的影響並不一致。

幣圈等立法 銀行看資本規定

加密貨幣業希望把川普任內的監管政策寫進法律，降低政策隨政府更迭而改變的風險。9月，川普支持的加密貨幣市場結構法案《CLARITY法案》未能在參院取得進展，交易平台Coinbase(COIN-US)與穩定幣發行商Circle(CRCL-US)股價當時一度跌達11%。若民主黨席次增加，業界要爭取法案過關，可能得接受更嚴格的消費者保障，以及對付息型穩定幣的限制。
銀行業則關注資本規定。聯邦監管機構估計，現行提案可使大型銀行的資本要求降低約4.8%，騰出數十億美元用於放款或回饋股東。相關規則由聯準會(Fed)訂定，參院則能透過人事同意權影響未來由誰填補職缺。民主黨若掌控任一院，也可透過委員會調閱企業文件、傳喚高層出席聽證會。部分民主黨議員已就白宮宴會廳捐款及關稅豁免索取資料。

AI資料中心擴建 電網升級誰買單

摩根士丹利估計，微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)及臉書母公司Meta(META-US)等雲端業者，2027年資本支出將超過1兆美元。隨著資料中心用電需求攀升，居民也愈來愈在意電費。《CNBC》10月調查顯示，63%的登記選民反對在住家方圓10英里(約16公里)內興建資料中心，僅13%支持。
爭議已進入國會。眾院9月以417票對3票通過一項法案，要求各州監管機構評估是否應由大型資料中心負擔新增的電力設施成本。部分民主黨議員主張應訂定強制規範，該案最終未能跨過參院程序表決門檻。若選後民主黨影響力上升，科技公司可能得承擔更多電網升級費用；至於個別設施能在哪裡接上電網、何時動工，仍取決於州政府、地方政府及公用事業。
paras_en: Lockheed Martin (LMT-US) derives about 70% of its revenue from the U.S. government, but its plan to supply 850 F‑35 fighters over the next decade still requires congressional approval and funding. This is why Wall Street is watching this midterm cycle closely: if Democrats win either the House or the Senate, they can leverage budget negotiations for concessions and gain committee investigative powers. The number of defense contracts, the amount of revenue healthcare providers can protect, and who will foot the bill for power‑grid upgrades for AI data centers could all be impacted.

Morgan Stanley (MS-US) data shows that during Republican presidential administrations, if the midterms leave the two chambers split, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 23% in the year after the election; if Democrats control both chambers, the average gain is 16%. However, Ariana Salvatore, head of U.S. public‑policy research at the firm, cautions that history may not repeat itself this time. Even with a Democratic congressional majority, President Trump would retain veto power and substantial discretion over tariffs and federal regulation.

Defense orders and healthcare payments are both on the line. The White House has requested a $1.5 trillion defense budget for FY 2027 and an additional $87.6 billion for FY 2026, mainly for operations related to Iran. A Democratic advantage in Congress could prompt a review of spending tied to Iran and Israel while pushing for more aid to Ukraine. By contrast, deterrence of China, nuclear‑force modernization and missile defense enjoy bipartisan support. For Lockheed Martin, the F‑35 procurement framework with the Pentagon hinges on whether Congress authorizes multi‑year purchases and appropriates the funds, turning the aircraft into firm orders.

Healthcare is equally sensitive to the federal budget. The Kaiser Family Foundation (KFF), using Congressional Budget Office estimates, says the tax‑cut and spending bill signed by Trump last year will reduce cumulative Medicaid outlays by $911 billion through 2034. Molina Healthcare (MOH-US) earned $32.2 billion in premiums last year from Medicaid, representing 75% of its premium revenue. Even if Democrats capture only one chamber, they could negotiate to delay some cuts, helping insurers keep enrollee numbers up and easing hospitals’ burden of treating uninsured patients. At the same time, the same lawmakers may tighten scrutiny of premiums, drug prices and insurer profits, so the impact on health‑care stocks will be uneven.

The crypto industry wants to lock in the regulatory framework enacted under Trump into law to reduce the risk of policy swings with each administration. In September, the Trump‑backed crypto market‑structure bill, the CLARITY Act, stalled in the Senate, sending Coinbase (COIN-US) and stable‑coin issuer Circle (CRCL-US) shares down as much as 11% at the time. If Democrats gain more seats, the sector will push for the bill’s passage but may have to accept stricter consumer‑protection rules and limits on interest‑bearing stablecoins.

Banks are focused on capital rules. Federal regulators estimate that the current proposal would lower capital requirements for large banks by about 4.8%, freeing tens of billions of dollars for lending or shareholder returns. The rules are set by the Federal Reserve, while the Senate can influence who fills future vacancies through its consent power. A Democratic majority in either chamber could also use committees to subpoena corporate documents and summon executives for hearings; some Democratic members have already sought information on White House banquet‑hall donations and tariff exemptions.

Morgan Stanley projects that cloud giants such as Microsoft (MSFT-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US) and Meta (META-US) will spend over $1 trillion on capital expenditures by 2027. As data‑center electricity demand climbs, homeowners are increasingly concerned about their electric bills. A CNBC poll in October found that 63% of registered voters oppose building a data center within a 10‑mile (≈16 km) radius of their homes, while only 13% support it.

The controversy has moved to Congress. In September, the House passed a bill 417‑3 requiring state regulators to assess whether large data centers should bear the cost of new power‑grid infrastructure. Some Democratic lawmakers argue for mandatory standards, but the measure failed to clear the Senate’s voting threshold. If Democratic influence rises after the election, tech firms may have to shoulder more grid‑upgrade costs; the location and timing of individual facilities will still depend on state, local and utility decisions.

items.title: 槓桿狂潮+AI燒錢焦慮！策略師：持續四年的美股牛市恐在6-12個月內進入尾聲
items.title_en: Leverage Frenzy and AI Spending Anxiety! Strategist: Four-Year US Bull Market May End Within 6‑12 Months
paras: 隨著法人機構與散戶瘋狂加槓桿，加上巨頭們在AI基礎建設上燒錢帶來的回報焦慮，持續約四年的美股牛市恐正接近尾聲，一位長期關注市場週期的宏觀策略師最新示警，美股可能在未來6至12個月完成由牛轉熊的轉變。
《MarketWatch》報導，宏觀研究機構Macro Ops創辦人Alex Barrow最新撰文指出，市場風險正逐漸累積，但牛市尚未完全結束，未來股市仍可能上漲，不過投資者需面對更劇烈的價格波動。
Barrow認為，最值得警惕的是各類投資者的總體風險部位持續攀升。避險基金和散戶不斷擴大股票持倉，借款投資規模也不斷增加。這種高槓桿在逆轉時可能引發集中平倉，放大跌勢。今年7月和10月的調整已暴露問題，那斯達克10月跌近7%，創去年4月最差表現。
Barrow指出，夏季波動或標誌牛市進入尾聲，但築頂通常需要8-9個月，目前仍有上漲空間，只是波動將明顯增加。避險基金近期已增加空頭部位，接近市場中性。
AI投資熱潮及融資壓力是另一關鍵變量。Macro Ops曾較早佈局AI和記憶體晶片，但在2-3月漲勢加速時兌現大部分利潤。
Barrow表示，AI基建巨額資本支出令企業日益依賴債務融資。在AI投資與財政赤字共同作用下，通膨恐持續高漲，Fed恐需更大幅度緊縮。融資成本提高將增加資金難度，若AI投資增速進入平台期，恐衝擊經濟和金融市場。
近期，Meta、Alphabet和亞馬遜繼續提高AI資本開支，但市場對回報週期的擔憂增加，高盛預計AI投資增速接近峰值。
儘管對期中前景謹慎，Barrow未完全退出股市，而是側重短期戰術安排。記憶體晶片仍是看好領域，團隊近期已重新建立美光科技等寸。
他認為，AI結構性需求或延長半導體週期，韓股KOSPI遠期本益比處於低位。此外，估值下降的建築材料企業、受資料中心需求推動的天然氣生產商也在關注範圍內。電網不足制約資料中心建設，相關能源和建築領域存在機會。AI醫療及生物技術同樣在視野中，貴金屬則長期關注但仍在尋底。
Barrow警告，標普500對少數大型科技股依賴度高，部分公司股價營收比超10倍，估值集中度需警惕，其當前策略包括提高現金比例、分散持倉並關注今年遭拋售的優質企業如波克夏海瑟威，同時保留部分AI部位應對後期上漲。
paras_en: As institutions and retail investors wildly increase leverage and giants burn cash on AI infrastructure, the anxiety over returns may signal the end of the roughly four‑year US equity bull market. A macro strategist who has long tracked market cycles warned that the US market could flip from bull to bear within the next six to twelve months.

MarketWatch reported that Alex Barrow, founder of macro‑research firm Macro Ops, wrote that market risk is gradually building, but the bull market is not yet over; equities could still rise, though investors should expect much sharper price swings.

Barrow says the biggest warning sign is the overall risk exposure of all types of investors continuing to climb. Hedge funds and retail traders are expanding stock positions and borrowing more to invest. This high leverage could trigger a wave of forced liquidations in a reversal, amplifying declines. The corrections in July and October this year exposed the issue, with the Nasdaq falling nearly 7% in October, its worst month since April last year.

Barrow notes that summer volatility may mark the bull market’s tail end, but a peak‑to‑trough typically takes 8‑9 months, so there is still upside potential, albeit with markedly higher volatility. Hedge funds have recently added short positions, moving toward market‑neutral exposure.

The AI investment boom and financing pressure are another key variable. Macro Ops had an early stake in AI and memory chips, but cash‑ed out most of the gains when the rally accelerated in February‑March.

Barrow says massive AI‑infrastructure capex is making companies increasingly dependent on debt financing. Combined with AI spending and fiscal deficits, inflation could stay high and the Fed may need to tighten more aggressively. Higher financing costs will make capital harder to obtain, and if AI investment growth stalls, it could shock the economy and financial markets.
Recently Meta, Alphabet and Amazon have kept raising AI capex, but market concerns about the return horizon are growing; Goldman Sachs expects AI‑investment growth to be near its peak.

Although cautious about the near‑term outlook, Barrow has not fully exited equities, focusing instead on short‑term tactical moves. Memory chips remain a favored sector, and his team has recently rebuilt positions in companies such as Micron Technology.

He believes AI‑driven structural demand could extend the semiconductor cycle, with Korea’s KOSPI forward P/E still low. He is also watching undervalued building‑materials firms, natural‑gas producers buoyed by data‑center demand, and sees opportunities in energy and construction tied to grid constraints. AI in healthcare and biotech are on his radar, while precious metals remain a long‑term play but still searching for a bottom.

Barrow warns that the S&P 500 is heavily dependent on a few large tech stocks, some with price‑to‑sales ratios above 10×, so valuation concentration should be monitored. His current strategy includes raising cash, diversifying holdings, and targeting quality companies that were sold off this year such as Berkshire Hathaway, while retaining some AI exposure for potential later upside.

items.title: 〈財報前瞻〉記憶體漲價有多傷？蘋果上季獲利增幅恐創六季來最小
items.title_en: <Earnings Preview> How Much Will Memory Price Hikes Hurt? Apple’s Profit Growth May Be the Slowest in Six Quarters
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)將於美股周一(2日)盤後公布財報。華爾街預估，蘋果上季營收可望年增近11%，但記憶體成本攀升，淨利增幅恐僅約6%，為六季來最慢。9月接替庫克的特納斯將首度以執行長身分主持法說會，投資人想從他的年底購物旺季展望中，看出摺疊iPhone等新品能否抵銷成本壓力。

記憶體漲價壓抑獲利 摺疊iPhone銷售落在旺季

根據倫敦證交所集團彙整的分析師預估，蘋果2026會計年度第四季(7至9月)營收可望達1,133.9億美元，淨利約290.4億美元。其中，iPhone營收估年增約15%至565.4億美元，增幅較前一季的約22%放緩。
這份財報只涵蓋iPhone 18 Pro系列開賣後的9天。蘋果首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo於10月23日上市，與智慧家庭中樞、首批觸控螢幕筆電同樣在新會計年度第一季才開始出貨。這也是市場格外重視旺季展望的原因：新品開始貢獻營收之際，蘋果也正面對庫克形容為「百年一遇洪水」的記憶體漲勢。
iPhone Duo在美國要價1,999美元起，開放線上訂購後數分鐘內便售罄。但部分買家反映，內螢幕中央摺痕處出現裂痕或線條，蘋果已提供換機服務。市調機構IDC分析師Nabila Popal預期，Duo仍將供不應求，眼前的考驗是蘋果能多快替受影響的買家換機。美國銀行(BAC-US)估計，Duo買家平均得等79天才能收貨，部分訂單交期已排到明年1月。

服務成長放緩 AI代理能否帶來新收入

蘋果今年以來股價上漲約27%，表現優於微軟(MSFT-US)、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、臉書母公司Meta(META-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)。隨著投資人愈來愈在意興建AI基礎設施的成本，蘋果對大規模支出相對審慎，反倒成為股價優勢。不過，分析師預估，蘋果上季服務營收年增近10%至315.6億美元，增幅恐為逾三年來最慢，特納斯對新版Siri及AI策略的說法也因此受到關注。
Meta的AI代理Muse近幾周迅速登上App Store排行榜前段班。遭蘋果控告涉嫌竊取營業祕密的OpenAI，也在開發可能挑戰iPhone地位的裝置。蘋果則把新版Siri的客群鎖定在一般消費者，強調使用者信任與隱私。
持有蘋果股票的Synovus Trust投資組合經理Dan Morgan指出，近期AI代理的進展已大幅超前新版Siri目前能提供的體驗。他認為，投資人還想知道，即使下一款熱門AI代理出自其他公司，蘋果能否透過App Store上架這些服務，並從中抽成。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) will release its earnings after the market closes on Monday (the 2nd) in the U.S. markets. Wall Street expects Apple’s revenue for the last quarter to grow about 11% year‑over‑year, but rising memory costs could limit net‑income growth to roughly 6%, the slowest in six quarters. In September, Tim Turner, who will succeed Tim Cook, will chair the earnings call for the first time as CEO, and investors will look to his outlook for the year‑end shopping season to see whether new products such as a foldable iPhone can offset cost pressures.

According to analyst estimates compiled by the London Stock Exchange Group, Apple’s fiscal 2026 fourth‑quarter (July‑September) revenue could reach $113.39 billion, with net income around $29.04 billion. iPhone revenue is projected to rise about 15% year‑over‑year to $56.54 billion, a slowdown from the roughly 22% growth seen in the prior quarter.

The earnings preview only covers the first nine days after the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro series. Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, is slated to launch on October 23, and like its smart‑home hub and the first batch of touchscreen‑laptop devices, it will not begin shipping until the first quarter of the new fiscal year. This timing makes the holiday‑season outlook especially important: as new products start contributing revenue, Apple is also confronting a memory‑price surge that Cook described as a “once‑in‑a‑century flood.”

The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999 in the United States and sold out within minutes of opening online orders. Some buyers, however, reported cracks or lines at the central fold of the inner screen, and Apple has offered replacement devices. IDC analyst Nabila Popal expects the Duo to remain in excess demand, with the key challenge being how quickly Apple can replace affected customers. Bank of America (BAC-US) estimates Duo buyers wait an average of 79 days for delivery, with some orders pushed out to January 2027.

Apple’s stock has risen about 27% so far this year, outperforming Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). As investors become increasingly sensitive to the cost of building AI infrastructure, Apple’s relatively cautious large‑scale spending has become a stock‑price advantage. Nevertheless, analysts project Apple’s services revenue for the quarter to grow nearly 10% year‑over‑year to $31.56 billion, likely the slowest growth in more than three years, putting a spotlight on Turner’s comments about the new Siri and AI strategy.

Meta’s AI agent Muse has surged to the top of the App Store rankings in recent weeks. OpenAI, sued by Apple for alleged trade‑secret theft, is also developing devices that could challenge the iPhone’s dominance. Apple is positioning the new Siri for the mass‑consumer market, emphasizing user trust and privacy.

Synovus Trust portfolio manager Dan Morgan, who holds Apple stock, said recent advances in AI agents have far outpaced the experience the new Siri can currently deliver. He added that investors still want to know whether, even if the next popular AI agent comes from another company, Apple can host those services on the App Store and capture a cut of the revenue.

items.title: 幣安快速流出36億美元資金後 撤離速度已趨緩 用戶權衡安全風險
paras: 全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)上周遭北韓駭客組織襲擊，被盜走高達 63 億美元資產，創下歷史上最大規模的金融搶案。在暫停提款服務3日後，幣安於周日重啟部分提款功能，前 9.5 小時內淨流出金額達 36.4 億美元。
然而，幣安官方與最新市場數據顯示，資金流出潮已逐漸放緩並趨於穩定。

官方承擔全額損失 提款陸續恢復

面對安全危機，幣安強調用戶資產安全未受影響，並已透過內部儲備與安全基金補足損失。幣安執行長鄧偉政(Richard Teng)表示，平台已展開「分階段恢復提款」，並承諾：「幣安將自行承擔被盜資金，不會由用戶承擔。」
幣安共同執行長何一在社群平台 X 發文指出：「我們目前的首要任務是確保環境安全，之後用戶即可提領資金，幣安也將恢復運作。」
此外，幣安創辦人趙長鵬談及市場走勢時提及，許多加密貨幣社群成員可能沒意識到，比特幣未出現更大跌幅，很大程度上要歸功於美國聯邦調查局(FBI)等執法機構的及時介入。

未出現恐慌性撤資

雖然此次提款規模龐大，但僅占幣安超過 1,500 億美元總資產的 2.1% 左右，分析師多認為此流出幅度相對溫和。香港數位資產金融服務公司 HashKey Group 資深研究員Tim Sun指出：「這尚未引發廣泛恐慌或大規模集中提款」，但安全疑慮可能會影響做市商與機構投資人未來在加密貨幣市場的資金配置。
美國區塊鏈分析公司 TRM Labs 全球政策主管Ari Redbord分析，現貨比特幣 ETF 出現 6.43 億美元資金流出，並有超過 13 億美元的槓桿部位遭平倉。他強調：「加密貨幣交易所遭駭，就像是以網際網路速度進行的銀行搶劫，為管理他人資金的負責人創造了極不穩定的風險輪廓。」
加密資產追回公司 iSanctuary 創辦人Jonathan Benton補充表示：「加密貨幣的未來不取決於有多少資金進入市場，而取決於這些資金在市場中的安全性。」
在一般投資人層面，許多用戶並未選擇全數撤離。新加坡亞太 Web3 AI 協會副主席Jay Koh表示：「我不會將所有資金從幣安撤出，因為中心化交易所在流動性、交易與市場接入方面，持續扮演重要角色。」
39 歲的幣安用戶Ryan Tan表示不急於提領，因為自4年前的 FTX 倒閉事件後，他就已習慣將大多數資產放在個人錢包保管。

items.title: 1150億美元押注AI！邁威爾收購Lumentum 挑戰博通
items.title_en: $115 Billion Bet on AI! Marvell to Acquire Lumentum, Challenging Broadcom
paras: 客製化晶片大廠邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周一(2日)宣布，將以全股票交易收購光通訊元件製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)，含債務在內的交易總值達1,150億美元，為今年規模最大的併購案之一。邁威爾押注，科技巨頭持續擴建AI資料中心，連接晶片所需的高速光通訊元件將持續供不應求。這筆交易也將擴充邁威爾的產品線，使其更有本錢與博通(AVGO-US)爭奪訂單。
依協議，Lumentum每股換股對價為1,132美元，較10月28日併購消息曝光前的收盤價溢價23.9%，股權交易價值為1,025.4億美元。邁威爾估計，合併後雙方產品可觸及的市場規模將擴大至5,500億美元。周一美股盤前，邁威爾上漲2.8%，Lumentum則暫停交易。

從客製化晶片到高速光通訊 邁威爾擴大挑戰博通

邁威爾近年協助亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等科技巨頭開發客製化AI晶片與資料中心網路技術，市值已突破1,700億美元。相較之下，博通長期擔任Google的主要客製化晶片合作夥伴，還能一次供應多種AI資料中心硬體。Lumentum的規模約為邁威爾的一半，收購後，邁威爾除了能替客戶設計晶片，也能供應讓資料在晶片之間高速傳輸的光通訊元件。
邁威爾今年8月已打入Google供應鏈，簽約供應與Google自研AI處理器搭配使用的晶片。這項協議到2033會計年度為止，最高可為邁威爾帶來1,200億美元銷售額，Google也取得買進價值122億美元邁威爾股份的權利。Google母公司為Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)。
輝達(NVDA-US)今年稍早也分別向邁威爾和Lumentum各投資20億美元。輝達執行長黃仁勳6月點名邁威爾有望成為下一家市值突破1兆美元的企業，帶動其股價創新高。邁威爾全年營收已從2021會計年度的30億美元，增至2026會計年度的82億美元。

美國擬限中國光收發模組 Lumentum有望受惠

AI代理與聊天機器人應用增加，資料中心內數千顆晶片需要更快的光通訊連線。邁威爾今年2月才以35億美元完成收購Celestial AI，擴充光子技術業務。此次收購Lumentum，則是邁威爾自2021年以100億美元買下Inphi以來，規模最大的一筆交易。
Lumentum的競爭對手包括美國光通訊廠Coherent(COHR-US)及中國的中際旭創(300308-CN)。美國正研議禁止新的中國製光收發模組進入市場，若提案實施，部分需求可能轉向美國供應商，Lumentum也有望受惠。
自雙方洽談併購的消息於上月底曝光以來，Lumentum股價已下跌約8%，邁威爾則下跌約22%。這段期間，英特爾(INTC-US)財測疲弱，加劇晶片股的全面賣壓。
paras_en: Marvell Technology (MRVL-US), a major custom‑chip maker, announced on Monday (the 2nd) that it will acquire optical‑components manufacturer Lumentum (LITE-US) in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion including debt, making it one of the largest mergers of the year. Marvell is betting that tech giants will keep expanding AI data centers, creating sustained shortage for the high‑speed optical components needed to connect chips. The deal will also broaden Marvell’s product line, giving it more firepower to compete with Broadcom (AVGO-US) for orders.

Under the agreement, Lumentum’s share‑exchange price is $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium to its closing price before the acquisition news broke on Oct. 28, valuing the equity portion at $102.54 billion. Marvell estimates that the combined product portfolio will address a market of $550 billion after the merger. In pre‑market trading on Monday, Marvell rose 2.8% while Lumentum’s shares were halted.

From custom chips to high‑speed optics, Marvell expands its challenge to Broadcom. In recent years Marvell has helped tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN-US) develop custom AI chips and data‑center networking technology, pushing its market cap past $170 billion. By contrast, Broadcom has long been Google’s primary custom‑chip partner and can supply a range of AI data‑center hardware in one go. Lumentum is roughly half the size of Marvell, and after the acquisition Marvell will not only design chips for customers but also provide the optical components that enable ultra‑fast data transfer between chips.

Marvell entered Google’s supply chain in August, signing a contract to provide chips that work with Google’s in‑house AI processor. The agreement runs through fiscal 2033 and could generate up to $120 billion in sales for Marvell, while Google secures the right to purchase $12.2 billion worth of Marvell stock. Google’s parent is Alphabet (GOOGL-US, GOOG-US).

Earlier this year Nvidia (NVDA-US) invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang singled out Marvell in June as a candidate to become the next trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap company, sending its stock to new highs. Marvell’s annual revenue has grown from $3 billion in fiscal 2021 to $8.2 billion in fiscal 2026.

The U.S. is poised to limit Chinese optical transceiver modules, which could benefit Lumentum. Growing AI agents and chat‑bot usage mean thousands of chips in data centers need faster optical links. In February Marvell completed a $3.5 billion acquisition of Celestial AI to expand its photonics business. The Lumentum deal is Marvell’s largest since it bought Inphi for $10 billion in 2021.

Lumentum’s rivals include U.S. optics firm Coherent (COHR-US) and China’s Zhongji Xuchuang (300308-CN). The U.S. is considering a ban on new Chinese‑made optical transceiver modules entering the market; if enacted, some demand could shift to U.S. suppliers, potentially benefiting Lumentum.

Since the merger talks were disclosed at the end of last month, Lumentum’s share price has fallen about 8% and Marvell’s about 22%. During that period, Intel’s (INTC-US) weak guidance added to broad selling pressure on chip stocks.

items.title: 大量新興雲端業者將在1到3年內破產？Bernstein警告：商業模式存在「致命」風險
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資熱潮持續延燒，但新興雲端業者（Neocloud）可能正面臨一場尚未浮現的財務危機。Bernstein最新研究報告引述資料中心法律專家Jeffrey Moerdler的分析指出，Neocloud業者普遍存在長短期租約錯配問題，部分企業恐在未來1至3年內陸續破產，情況可能重演共享辦公室業者WeWork的崩潰模式。
Moerdler自1990年起專注於資料中心及數位基礎設施法律業務，目前帶領約10名律師的團隊，每年處理數百筆交易，同時經手約30至40個專案。
他直言，Neocloud的商業模式令人擔憂，形同「WeWork 2.0」。
問題在於，Neocloud業者通常簽訂長達15年的資料中心租約，但向客戶提供的算力服務合約卻短得多，可能只有幾天、幾週或幾個月，即使較長的合約也通常僅有1至3年。
一旦客戶不再續約，業者收入便可能中斷，卻仍須持續承擔長期租金與設施成本。
Moerdler預期，未來1至3年將有部分Neocloud業者陷入破產困境，尤其是規模較小、專注特定垂直產業的AI新創公司，例如專門服務律師事務所或服飾產業的業者，若無法創造足夠收入，將難以維持營運。

資料中心擔保從全額縮水至80% 開發商風險升高

除了租約期限錯配，資料中心融資與租賃合約中的信用擔保結構也正在改變，進一步增加開發商的財務風險。
Moerdler指出，約10個月前，一家超大型雲端服務商率先改變市場慣例，不再提供涵蓋全部租約義務的信用擔保，而是僅承諾擔保約80%的建設貸款。
換言之，超出貸款保障範圍的建設成本，以及其餘20%的貸款風險，都必須由開發商自行承擔。
更值得注意的是，這類擔保通常會在租約初始期間採直線法逐年攤銷。以10年期租約為例，到了第7年或第8年，原有擔保價值幾乎已經耗盡。
與此同時，擔保方也開始要求更廣泛的介入權（Step-in Rights），也就是在需要履行擔保義務時，能夠直接接管相關資料中心空間及電力資源。過去這類安排通常由擔保方與客戶私下協商，如今則逐漸納入正式租約條款。
Moerdler表示，過去10至12個月，他經手涉及超大型雲端業者、AI公司及晶片製造商信用增強的交易，無一例外都已從全額租約擔保轉向有限度擔保。
資料中心合約暗藏四大風險 開發商恐失去資產控制權
Moerdler也提醒，資料中心租約中有多項容易被忽略的條款，可能在日後造成重大損失。
首先是「隨意終止權」（Termination-for-Convenience），允許租戶在特定條件下，無須提出特定違約事由便可終止合約。這類條款經常出現在超大型雲端業者的標準合約中，卻可能讓開發商在投入大量建設成本後，仍面臨租約提前終止的風險。
其次是信用擔保額度不足或攤銷速度過快，導致租約進入後期時，開發商原本仰賴的信用保障已大幅減弱。
第三，租約轉讓也可能使原有信用保護失效。如果租戶將租約轉讓給第三方，卻未能同步保留原本的信用增強安排，開發商便可能失去重要的風險緩衝。
第四則是租戶取得過多園區控制權，包括擴張權、縮減權，以及限制開發商開發相鄰土地的權利，可能進一步削弱開發商對自有資產的處置彈性。
Moerdler分享一個案例指出，曾有客戶委託他審查一份Neocloud租約，他在一個週末內便提出約50項修改意見，並建議若對方不願接受其中四分之三的修改，就不應進行交易。
最終，Neocloud僅願意修改約10%至20%的條款，客戶因此決定放棄簽約。

Neocloud倒閉未必是壞事 關鍵在開發商能否收回設施

不過，Neocloud破產對資料中心開發商而言，也未必完全是負面結果。
Moerdler認為，如果開發商事先建立足夠的信用保障，在租戶倒閉後順利收回設施，反而可能取得成本更具競爭力的資料中心資產。
他以每兆瓦建設成本1,000萬美元為例，假設開發商事先取得相當於建設成本30%的信用增強保障，包括信用狀、現金保證金、預付款或投資級企業擔保，那麼即使Neocloud破產，開發商收回設施後，實際成本基礎便可降至每兆瓦700萬美元。
由於資料中心已經完工，開發商可以重新出租設施，並以低於其他每兆瓦建設成本超過1,000萬美元的競爭者的價格進入市場。
但這項策略有一個重要前提，就是開發商必須能夠迅速收回資產。Moerdler指出，在紐約等地，收回不動產可能耗時1至2年，期間將大幅削弱這種成本優勢。

電力取得時間成選址關鍵 超過48個月吸引力大減

隨著AI資料中心需求快速成長，資料中心選址的評估標準也出現轉變。Moerdler認為，過去業界重視地理位置，如今能否及時取得電力，才是決定資產價值的關鍵。
他將資料中心電力供應時程分為四個等級：12個月內可取得電力屬於最高級的「白金資產」；12至24個月為「黃金資產」；24至48個月為「白銀資產」；若等待時間超過48個月，商業吸引力便大幅下降。
舉例而言，一座規劃容量400兆瓦的資料中心園區，即使短期內只能取得100兆瓦電力，只要能在12至24個月內交付，且後續供電計畫具有可信度，仍具有相當高的投資價值。
他也指出，德州電力可靠度委員會（ERCOT）目前收到的待審電力申請量，已達德州電網現有容量的4倍，其中包含大量投機性申請。電力監管機構正透過押金及保證金要求，淘汰缺乏客戶、專業能力與資金支持的投機業者。

AI資料中心需求未降溫 城市型推理設施成新商機

儘管市場對AI基礎建設投資能否持續抱持疑慮，Moerdler根據目前經手的交易指出，資料中心需求仍呈現快速成長，尚未出現放緩跡象。
他透露，目前正在處理的專案包括德州一座3吉瓦（GW）資料中心園區，以及一筆出售德州Batch Zero資料中心園區的交易，規模超過2吉瓦，交易金額約20億美元。
不過，市場參與者對投機性交易的風險意識也明顯提高，承銷與融資標準正逐步趨嚴。
展望未來3至5年，Moerdler預期，隨著大型AI模型訓練需求逐漸趨於飽和，市場將有更多需求轉向城市及近郊的小型AI推理節點。
他指出，過去幾年資料中心產業經歷大量併購，中型營運商數量大幅減少，導致250千瓦至2兆瓦規模的在地資料中心供給不足，相關租賃價格過去兩年已上漲50%至100%。
Moerdler並透露，近期已在紐約市區完成一筆2兆瓦資料中心租約，承租方是一家AI推理設施業者。這也反映出，在大型AI訓練設施持續擴張之際，鄰近城市的小型推理運算基礎設施，正逐漸成為資料中心市場的新成長機會。

items.title: 泰國10月企業信心降至45.2 水災衝擊電子業生產與物流
items.title_en: Thailand's October Business Confidence Falls to 45.2 as Floods Hit Electronics Production and Logistics
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 泰國央行公布，10月企業信心指數由9月的48.1降至45.2，製造業與非製造業信心同步下滑，主要受到中東戰事持續推高企業成本，以及國內水災影響生產與物流所致。其中，電子電機產業因部分倉庫及供電設施受損，加上道路運輸受阻，原料進貨、產品出貨及員工通勤均受到影響。
製造業信心已連續兩個月低於50，幾乎所有產業都出現下滑，其中食品與飲料業受創較重。水災造成部分農產品原料損失，包括罐頭水果及動物飼料相關原料，業者同時擔心聖嬰現象可能使後續農業產量減少，增加原料供應的不確定性。
電子與電機製造業則面臨不同問題。部分倉儲設施及電力系統因淹水受損，影響工廠正常運作；運輸中斷也使原料配送、成品出貨及員工往返工廠更加困難。這些問題主要來自水災造成的短期營運干擾，而非電子產品需求全面下滑。
非製造業同樣受到成本上漲及水災影響，運輸、貿易與倉儲業信心均下滑。批發業方面，化學品、家具及建材等商品信心轉弱；旅館業則因部分設施需要修復，加上部分旅客延後行程，短期營運受到影響。
不過，企業對未來三個月的看法略有改善，預期信心指數升至51.3，主要由零售及營建業帶動。汽車零售商預期，消費者可能趕在貨物稅調高前提前購車，年底車展也有助於後續交車；民生消費品則可望受惠於觀光旺季需求，公共設施與住宅修復工程也將增加營建業工作量。
製造業未來三個月信心大致持平，但產業表現分歧。食品與飲料業預期隨農產品進入收成季節，糖及水果罐頭等加工產品生產增加，加上節慶飲料需求支撐，相關信心指數六個月來首度回到50以上。汽車製造業也預期年底車展將帶來新增訂單。
相較之下，部分電子產品仍未受惠於電子產業景氣循環，包括印表機零組件及眼鏡鏡片等產品，業者對未來三個月的信心反而下滑。家電製造業則持續面臨供給過剩與價格競爭壓力。另一方面，企業對未來成本及投資的看法仍偏保守，中東戰事帶來的不確定性尚未消除。

paras_en: On November 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The Bank of Thailand announced that the October business confidence index dropped to 45.2 from 48.1 in September, with confidence in both manufacturing and non‑manufacturing sectors slipping. The decline is mainly due to rising corporate costs from the ongoing Middle‑East conflict and domestic flood damage that disrupted production and logistics. In the electronics and electrical equipment sector, some warehouses and power facilities were damaged and road transport was blocked, affecting raw‑material procurement, product shipments and employee commuting.

Manufacturing confidence has stayed below 50 for two consecutive months, with almost every industry posting declines, especially the food and beverage sector. Floods caused losses of certain agricultural raw materials, including canned fruit and animal‑feed inputs, and firms also worry that the El Niño phenomenon could reduce future agricultural output, increasing uncertainty over raw‑material supply.

The electronics and electrical equipment manufacturing sector faces a different set of problems. Some storage facilities and power systems were damaged by flooding, hampering normal factory operations; transport disruptions also made raw‑material deliveries, finished‑goods shipments and employee commutes more difficult. These issues stem from short‑term operational interruptions caused by the floods rather than a broad drop in demand for electronic products.

Non‑manufacturing sectors are likewise affected by higher costs and flood impacts, with confidence falling in transportation, trade and warehousing. In wholesale, confidence in chemicals, furniture and building‑materials weakened; the hotel industry also suffers short‑term operational hits as some facilities need repairs and some travelers postpone trips.

Nevertheless, firms’ outlook for the next three months shows a slight improvement, with the confidence index expected to rise to 51.3, driven mainly by retail and construction. Car dealers anticipate that consumers may rush to purchase vehicles before a higher goods tax takes effect, and the year‑end auto show should help subsequent deliveries; consumer goods are expected to benefit from peak tourism demand, while public‑facility and residential repair projects will boost construction work.

Manufacturing confidence over the next three months is expected to remain roughly flat, but performance diverges across industries. Food and beverage firms expect higher production of processed items such as sugar and canned fruit as agricultural harvests begin, and festive‑season beverage demand should support confidence, pushing the sector’s index above 50 for the first time in six months. The automotive manufacturing sector also expects new orders from the year‑end auto show.

In contrast, some electronic products have not benefited from the industry’s cyclical upswing, including printer components and eyeglass lenses, with firms’ confidence for the next three months actually declining. Home‑appliance manufacturers continue to face oversupply and price‑competition pressure. Meanwhile, companies remain cautious about future costs and investment, as uncertainties from the Middle‑East conflict have not yet been resolved.

items.title: 巴菲特48年沒喝水？最愛櫻桃可樂 可口可樂投資增值逾20倍
items.title_en: Buffett Hasn't Drank Water in 48 Years? His Favorite is Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Investment Has Grown Over 20‑Fold
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 「股神」巴菲特Warren Buffett對可口可樂Coca-Cola(KO-US)的喜愛眾所皆知，但他究竟有多愛喝汽水？潘興廣場資本管理公司(Pershing Square Capital Management)創辦人艾克曼Bill Ackman近日透露，巴菲特曾在一次私人晚餐中告訴他，自己已經48年沒有喝過水，平常最喜歡的飲料就是櫻桃可樂(Cherry Coke)。
艾克曼在投資Podcast節目Equity Mates Investing中回憶，幾年前他邀請巴菲特到家中用餐，事先準備了巴菲特最愛的櫻桃可樂。用餐期間，艾克曼詢問巴菲特想喝一般飲用水還是氣泡水，沒想到兩種都遭到拒絕。當他進一步詢問巴菲特是否喝水時，巴菲特回答，自己已經48年沒喝過水。
巴菲特長期以來都有大量飲用可口可樂的習慣。他在2015年接受《Fortune》訪問時曾表示，每天至少喝五罐12盎司的可口可樂，約相當於1.77公升。他當時還開玩笑說，如果一天攝取2,700大卡熱量，其中約四分之一來自可口可樂。
巴菲特對櫻桃可樂的喜愛已有數十年。早在1985年度的波克夏Berkshire Hathaway(BRK.B-US)股東信中，他便宣布結束長達48年的另一款汽水飲用習慣，改喝櫻桃可樂，甚至將櫻桃可樂指定為波克夏股東大會的官方飲料。
除了個人喜好，可口可樂也是巴菲特最具代表性的長期投資之一。波克夏自1980年代末開始大量買進可口可樂股票，累計投入約13億美元，持股比重約9%。這筆投資在去年12月底已增值至約280億美元，相當於原始投資成本的21.5倍，尚未計入多年來領取的現金股利。
巴菲特的飲食習慣同樣相當固定，除了可口可樂，也喜歡麥當勞早餐、漢堡、薯條、熱狗、爆米花、餅乾及冰淇淋。根據傳記《雪球：巴菲特的財富人生》記載，1995年巴菲特與微軟創辦人比爾蓋茲Bill Gates夫婦前往中國進行17天旅行時，同行人員還特別安排飯店廚師替巴菲特準備漢堡與薯條。
當年一行人參觀中國長城時，其他人準備了香檳，巴菲特則依照個人習慣喝櫻桃可樂。即使出國旅行，他仍維持多年來熟悉的飲食方式。

paras_en: November 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – The “Oracle of Omaha” Warren Buffett’s love for Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) is well known, but how much soda does he actually drink? Bill Ackman, founder of Pershing Square Capital Management, recently revealed that at a private dinner Buffett told him he hasn’t had water in 48 years and that his go‑to drink is Cherry Coke.

Ackman recalled on his Equity Mates Investing podcast that a few years ago he invited Buffett to dinner at his home and stocked the fridge with Cherry Coke, Buffett’s favorite. During the meal Ackman asked whether Buffett wanted still water or sparkling water, and both were refused. When he pressed further, Buffett said he hasn’t drunk water for 48 years.

Buffett has long been a heavy Coke consumer. In a 2015 Fortune interview he said he drinks at least five 12‑ounce cans of Coca‑Cola a day – roughly 1.77 liters – and joked that if his daily intake is 2,700 calories, about a quarter comes from Coke.

His fondness for Cherry Coke dates back decades. In Berkshire Hathaway’s 1985 shareholder letter he announced he was ending a 48‑year habit of another soda in favor of Cherry Coke, even designating it the official beverage for the Berkshire shareholders’ meeting.

Beyond personal preference, Coca‑Cola is one of Buffett’s most iconic long‑term holdings. Berkshire began buying large blocks of the stock in the late 1980s, investing about $1.3 billion for roughly a 9 % stake. By the end of December last year the investment had risen to about $28 billion – a 21.5‑times increase on the original cost, not counting decades of cash dividends.

Buffett’s diet is similarly consistent; besides Coke he enjoys McDonald’s breakfast, burgers, fries, hot dogs, popcorn, cookies and ice cream. According to the biography “Snowball: Warren Buffett’s Life and Business,” during a 17‑day 1995 China trip with Bill and Melinda Gates, the hotel chef prepared burgers and fries especially for him.
When the group visited the Great Wall, others brought champagne, but Buffett stuck to his habit and drank Cherry Coke. Even while traveling abroad he maintains his familiar eating routine.

items.title: 快訊／Marvell正式宣布1,150億美元收購Lumentum 擴大AI光通訊布局
items.title_en: Breaking News: Marvell Announces $115 B Acquisition of Lumentum to Expand AI Optical Communications Portfolio
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI資料中心規模持續擴大，高速光通訊逐漸成為繼運算晶片、記憶體之後的另一項關鍵技術。美國客製化AI晶片大廠邁威爾Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)宣布，將以全股票交易方式收購光通訊元件供應商Lumentum(LITE-US)，交易企業價值達1,150億美元，為2026年規模最大的併購案之一。華爾街分析師普遍認同這項交易的戰略價值，但也擔心收購價格過高及股權稀釋壓力。
根據協議，Marvell將以每股1,132美元的股票對價收購Lumentum，較10月28日傳出併購消息前的收盤價溢價23.9%，股權價值約1,025億美元，包含債務後的企業價值為1,150億美元。Marvell預估，合併後公司的潛在市場規模將擴大至5,500億美元，進一步強化與博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)在AI資料中心市場的競爭能力。
這項交易的核心在於掌握AI資料中心快速成長的光互連需求。Marvell主要提供客製化AI晶片、網路晶片及光通訊訊號處理技術，Lumentum則供應雷射與光學元件。隨著AI運算叢集規模擴大，晶片之間的資料傳輸頻寬與功耗逐漸成為效能瓶頸。Piper Sandler認為，Lumentum的高功率雷射技術是下一代AI網路的重要環節，而整合雙方技術有助於Marvell擴大產品布局。

供應鏈控制也是收購的重要考量。Lumentum部分AI光通訊產品產能已被預訂至2029年初，顯示市場需求仍相當強勁。Marvell今年2月才完成以35億美元收購光互連技術公司Celestial AI，此次再將原本的雷射元件供應商納入旗下，可進一步掌握關鍵光學元件供應能力。輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)今年也已分別向Marvell及Lumentum投資20億美元，反映AI晶片與光通訊供應鏈的整合趨勢。
不過，市場對高額收購成本仍有疑慮。Bernstein認為交易方向符合Marvell的長期策略，但綜效尚不明確；Morningstar則擔心，Lumentum股價此前已大幅上漲，收購溢價可能使Marvell付出過高代價。Rosenblatt估計，交易可能使Marvell 2028年與2029年每股盈餘分別受到5.0%及2.4%的稀釋影響。
市場反應也顯示投資人對交易價格有所保留。自10月底傳出併購談判消息後，Marvell股價累計下跌約22%，Lumentum也回落約8%。不過，Piper Sandler仍維持Marvell「加碼」評等及400美元目標價，看好光通訊需求長期成長。

Marvell近年受惠大型科技公司擴大客製化AI晶片投資，2026會計年度營收達82億美元，較2021會計年度的30億美元增加逾一倍。今年8月，公司更取得Google AI處理器周邊晶片供應合約，至2033會計年度的潛在銷售額最高達1,200億美元。此次收購Lumentum將使Marvell從AI晶片及網路技術進一步延伸至光學元件製造，但在交易規模大幅提高後，如何將光通訊需求成長轉化為足以支撐收購成本的獲利，將成為市場後續觀察重點。

paras_en: Nov 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers continue to grow, high‑speed optical communications are becoming a key technology alongside compute chips and memory. U.S. custom AI‑chip giant Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) announced it will acquire optical‑components supplier Lumentum (LITE‑US) in an all‑stock deal valued at $115 billion, making it one of the largest M&A transactions of 2026. Wall Street analysts broadly endorse the strategic rationale but warn the purchase price may be high and could dilute equity.

Under the agreement, Marvell will pay $1,132 per share in stock, a 23.9% premium to Lumentum’s closing price before the merger rumors surfaced on Oct. 28. The equity value is about $102.5 billion, and the enterprise value, including debt, totals $115 billion. Marvell estimates the combined company’s addressable market could expand to $550 billion, strengthening its competitive position against Broadcom (AVGO‑US) in the AI data‑center market.

The deal centers on capturing the fast‑growing demand for optical interconnects in AI data centers. Marvell provides custom AI chips, networking silicon and optical‑signal processing, while Lumentum supplies lasers and optical components. As AI compute clusters scale, bandwidth and power consumption between chips become performance bottlenecks. Piper Sandler says Lumentum’s high‑power laser technology is a critical piece of next‑generation AI networking, and integrating the two firms’ technologies will broaden Marvell’s product portfolio.

Supply‑chain control is another key motive. Capacity for some of Lumentum’s AI optical‑communication products is already booked through early 2029, indicating strong demand. Marvell completed a $3.5 billion acquisition of optical‑interconnect firm Celestial AI in February, and adding the laser‑component supplier further secures critical optical‑component supply. NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) has also invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum this year, reflecting a trend toward integrating AI‑chip and optical‑communication supply chains.

However, the market remains uneasy about the high purchase price. Bernstein says the transaction aligns with Marvell’s long‑term strategy but the synergies are unclear; Morningstar worries that Lumentum’s share price has already surged, making the premium potentially excessive. Rosenblatt estimates the deal could dilute Marvell’s 2028 and 2029 earnings per share by about 5.0% and 2.4%, respectively.

Investor reaction shows price concerns. Since the merger talks emerged at the end of October, Marvell’s stock has fallen roughly 22% and Lumentum’s about 8%. Nonetheless, Piper Sandler maintains a “Buy” rating on Marvell with a $400 price target, citing long‑term growth in optical‑communication demand.

Marvell has benefited in recent years from large tech firms expanding custom AI‑chip investments, reporting FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion, more than double the $3.0 billion in FY2021. In August, the company secured a Google AI‑processor peripheral‑chip supply contract that could generate up to $120 billion in sales through FY2033. The Lumentum acquisition will extend Marvell from AI chips and networking into optical‑component manufacturing, but the market will watch how the firm converts growing optical‑communication demand into profits sufficient to justify the sizable purchase price.

paras_en: November 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – US equities rebounded in pre‑market trading on November 2, with technology and AI‑related stocks stabilizing after a sharp October decline. Investors are turning their attention to this week’s earnings reports and the U.S. midterm elections. According to eSignal’s delayed quote as of 20:13 Taipei time, December‑expiry Dow Jones futures were up 220 points, or 0.42%, S&P 500 futures rose 33.5 points, or 0.44%, and Nasdaq‑100 futures climbed 236.75 points, or 0.83%.

Large tech firms continue to increase AI spending, and some are raising capital through bond issuances, which raises borrowing costs and heightens investor worries about the speed of capital recovery. Apple (AAPL‑US) is scheduled to release its earnings after the close on November 2 Eastern Time, and AMD (AMD‑US) will also report results later this week. items.title: AI光通訊需求強勁！住友電工光纜營收估增82%！EML、CW-LD產能爬坡仍有挑戰
items.title_en: Strong AI Optical‑Communication Demand! Sumitomo Electric’s Optical Cable Revenue Expected to Jump 82% – EML and CW‑LD Capacity Ramp‑Up Still Faces Challenges
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本住友電工Sumitomo Electric Industries(5802-JP)受惠AI資料中心光通訊需求增加，10月30日宣布將2026財年（截至2027年3月底）全年營業利益預測由4,500億日圓上修至5,000億日圓（約新台幣1,038億元），調升11.1%。其中，資訊通信部門全年營業利益預測由1,330億日圓提高至1,560億日圓，主要受到資料中心光纜需求強勁及生產效率改善帶動。不過，光電元件包括電吸收調變雷射（EML）、連續波雷射（CW-LD）及光收發器等新增產能仍有生產問題，可能影響第三季出貨。
住友電工是日本主要光纖、光纜及光電元件供應商，產品涵蓋光纖、預先裝配連接器的光纜，以及高速光通訊元件。隨著AI資料中心持續擴建，伺服器與交換器之間需要更多高速連線，帶動光纖及相關產品採購增加。其中，預先裝配連接器的光纜需求尤其強勁，已成為公司第二季資訊通信部門獲利增加的主要來源之一。
從最新財報來看，住友電工資訊通信部門第二季營收達1,150億日圓，較第一季865億日圓增加約33%；營業利益由272億日圓提高至340億日圓，季增25%。公司預估該部門全年營收達5,100億日圓，年增56%，營業利益則年增約101%至1,560億日圓，營業利益率預計由去年的23.7%提高至30.6%。
進一步拆解產品，住友電工預估2026財年光纖、光纜及相關配件營收達2,960億日圓，較去年1,625億日圓增加約82%；光電元件業務營收則預估由952億日圓提高至1,292億日圓，年增約36%。兩項業務均受惠資料中心需求，但光纜營收成長速度明顯較快。

相較於光纜需求已順利轉化為出貨及獲利，光電元件的產能擴充仍面臨挑戰。住友電工第一季發生的建廠及生產問題雖已解決，但新增產能爬坡時又出現其他問題，公司表示可能影響第三季（2026年10月至12月）出貨量。住友電工的光電元件產品涵蓋高速光通訊使用的電吸收調變雷射（EML）、連續波雷射（CW-LD）及光收發器等，可應用於800G、1.6T高速光模組與矽光子技術。公司先前曾指出，新增光電元件設備從安裝、試運轉到穩定生產約需六個月。
住友電工正加快擴充資訊通信產能，預估2026財年該部門資本支出達750億日圓，較去年237億日圓增加約216%，為近年最大投資規模之一。公司預估下半年資訊通信部門營業利益達948億日圓，較上半年612億日圓增加約55%，後續新增產能能否順利投入生產，將直接影響全年獲利目標的達成。

paras_en: November 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japan’s Sumitomo Electric Industries (5802‑JP) is benefiting from rising AI data‑center optical‑communication demand. On October 30 it announced that its FY2026 (ending March 2027) full‑year operating profit forecast has been raised from ¥450 billion to ¥500 billion (about NT$103.8 billion), an 11.1% increase. The information‑communication segment’s operating profit outlook was lifted from ¥133 billion to ¥156 billion, driven mainly by strong data‑center optical‑cable demand and improved production efficiency. However, new capacity for optoelectronic components such as electro‑absorption modulated lasers (EML), continuous‑wave lasers (CW‑LD) and optical transceivers still faces production issues that could affect third‑quarter shipments.

Sumitomo Electric is a major Japanese supplier of optical fibers, cables and optoelectronic components, offering products ranging from fibers and pre‑terminated connector cables to high‑speed optical‑communication devices. As AI data centers continue to expand, more high‑speed links are needed between servers and switches, boosting purchases of fibers and related products. In particular, demand for pre‑terminated connector cables is especially strong and has become one of the main contributors to the information‑communication segment’s profit growth in the second quarter.

From the latest financial results, the information‑communication segment posted second‑quarter revenue of ¥115 billion, up about 33% from ¥86.5 billion in the first quarter; operating profit rose from ¥27.2 billion to ¥34 billion, a 25% quarterly increase. The company forecasts full‑year revenue for the segment at ¥510 billion, a 56% year‑over‑year rise, and operating profit to more than double to ¥156 billion, lifting the operating margin from last year’s 23.7% to an estimated 30.6%.

Breaking down the product mix, Sumitomo Electric projects FY2026 revenue of ¥296 billion for optical fibers, cables and related accessories, up about 82% from ¥162.5 billion last year. Revenue from the optoelectronic components business is expected to climb from ¥95.2 billion to ¥129.2 billion, a roughly 36% increase. Both businesses benefit from data‑center demand, but cable revenue is growing markedly faster.

While cable demand has translated smoothly into shipments and profit, expanding capacity for optoelectronic components remains challenging. Problems that arose during plant construction and production in the first quarter have been resolved, but new‑capacity ramp‑up has encountered additional issues that could affect shipments in the third quarter (October‑December 2026). Sumitomo’s optoelectronic products include EMLs, CW‑LDs and optical transceivers used in 800 Gb/s, 1.6 Tb/s high‑speed optical modules and silicon‑photonic technologies. The company previously noted that bringing new optoelectronic equipment from installation and trial runs to stable production takes about six months.

Sumitomo Electric is accelerating the expansion of its information‑communication capacity, estimating FY2026 capital expenditures for the segment at ¥75 billion, up roughly 216% from ¥23.7 billion last year and representing one of its largest recent investments. The firm projects second‑half operating profit for the segment at ¥94.8 billion, about 55% higher than the first‑half’s ¥61.2 billion. Whether the newly added capacity can be brought online smoothly will directly affect the achievement of its full‑year profit target.

items.title: AI搶產能推升DRAM連漲九個月 2027年PC供應壓力難解
items.title_en: AI Grabs Capacity, Driving DRAM Up for Nine Consecutive Months; 2027 PC Supply Pressure Remains Hard to Resolve
paras: 2026年11月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心的高毛利訂單，正把記憶體產能從一般消費電子產品抽走。DRAM批發價截至今年9月已連續九個月上漲，主流16Gb DDR5在8月每顆約47.5美元，9月升至50美元，整體價格較2025年底翻倍。市場焦點已從需求復甦，轉向供給結構性排擠。
三星電子、SK海力士與美光合計掌握全球約九成DRAM市場。三大廠優先供應加速擴建資料中心的美國雲端巨頭，主因AI伺服器使用的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）獲利更高，導致PC等一般型產品可取得的產能不足。日本通路商指出，買方若不接受原廠報價，甚至可能拿不到貨；部分業者連既有客戶都無法充分配貨，新客戶訂單更直接婉拒。
供應吃緊也開始反映在終端市場。日本電子資訊技術產業協會調查顯示，4月至9月日本PC出貨量年減三成，記憶體急漲已成為製造與定價壓力。PC廠預期，2027年DRAM採購環境仍將對買方不利，只能透過長約與供應商協商，降低缺料對生產及出貨的衝擊。
這波循環與過往庫存調整不同，核心不是一般消費需求突然暴增，而是AI伺服器改寫產能配置。只要雲端業者資本支出維持高檔，HBM與高階伺服器記憶體就會持續吸走資源，支撐價格並擴大高階與通用型產品的供需落差。
英特爾Intel(INTC-US)對PC市場的最新預測，也進一步凸顯記憶體供應問題的影響。原先市場預估2027年全球PC出貨量約持平至年減7%，但英特爾預期明年市場將萎縮約10%，且記憶體供應緊張可能持續至2027年底，2028年能否改善仍有不確定性。

paras_en: On November 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – High‑margin AI data‑center orders are pulling memory capacity away from ordinary consumer electronics. DRAM wholesale prices have risen for nine straight months through September, with the mainstream 16‑Gb DDR5 costing about $47.5 per chip in August and $50 in September, roughly double the level at the end of 2025. Market focus has shifted from a demand recovery to a structural supply squeeze.

Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron together control roughly 90% of the global DRAM market. The three majors prioritize supplying U.S. cloud giants that are rapidly expanding data‑center capacity, because the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI servers yields higher margins, leaving insufficient capacity for general‑purpose products such as PCs. Japanese distributors say that if buyers do not accept the manufacturers’ quoted prices they may not receive any units at all; some vendors cannot fully allocate to existing customers, and new‑customer orders are being outright declined.

The tight supply is now showing up in the end market. A survey by Japan’s Electronic Information Technology Industry Association shows that PC shipments in Japan fell 30% year‑on‑year from April to September, and the sharp memory price surge has become a manufacturing and pricing pressure. PC makers expect that the DRAM procurement environment will remain unfavorable to buyers in 2027, and they can only mitigate material shortages and shipment impacts by negotiating long‑term contracts with suppliers.

This cycle differs from past inventory adjustments; the driver is not a sudden surge in ordinary consumer demand but the reallocation of capacity driven by AI servers. As long as cloud providers keep capex at a high level, HBM and high‑end server memory will continue to siphon resources, sustaining prices and widening the supply‑demand gap between high‑end and generic products.

Intel (INTC‑US)’s latest forecast for the PC market further highlights the impact of memory supply constraints. The market had previously estimated that global PC shipments in 2027 would be flat to a 7% decline year‑over‑year, but Intel now expects the market to shrink about 10% next year, with tight memory supply potentially persisting through the end of 2027 and uncertainty remaining about any improvement in 2028.

items.title: 日本央行鎖定12月升息 但中性利率的不確定性令前景蒙上陰影
items.title_en: BOJ Targets December Rate Hike, but Uncertainty Around the Neutral Rate Casts a Shadow Over the Outlook
paras: 日本央行在最新政策會議中，將政策利率維持在 1.25% 左右，並強調，基調性通膨已大致符合 2% 的物價目標。隨著市場普遍預測日銀 12 月將再次升息至 1.5%，但投資者仍懷疑，在升息至接近中性利率後，日銀會最終將利率帶向何處。
日銀於 10 月底公布的《經濟與物價情勢展望》報告全文中透露，在評估金融環境時，除了名目與實質利率外，無法直接控制的股市與匯率動態也具顯著影響。
針對利率走向與金融環境，日本央行總裁植田和男表示，10 月決定暫緩升息是為了「再多觀察一點」經濟與物價情勢，但委員會將持續聚焦物價上行風險，高機率於 12 月將政策利率調升至 1.5%。
植田指出，雖然整體金融條件仍屬寬鬆，但已注意到部分中小企業的融資條件出現趨緊跡象，日銀將密切關注該狀況是否進一步擴散。
前日銀官員、樂天證券經濟研究所首席經濟學家愛宕伸康分析，從日銀近期釋出的訊息來看，12 月升息「幾乎已成定局」。他進一步指出，明年的政策路徑較不確定，因為若隨後再次升息將使利率達到 1.75%，這可能已接近被視為對經濟中立的水準。
InvestingLive 分析師Justin Low指出，日銀報告將 2027 財年核心通膨預期上調至 2.6%，顯示通膨壓力持續累積；日銀目前雖仍在評估過去升息對金融環境的傳導效果，但遲早需要以實際行動回應市場，以維護市場對其政策方向與決心的信心。
根據日銀幕僚估算，日本的名目中立利率約落在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間。然而，由於中立利率無法直接觀測，且日本經歷長達30年的通縮環境，企業與家計部門對借貸成本上升極為敏感。日銀在推進政策正常化的過程中，必須在防止通膨過熱與維持經濟復甦之間謹慎平衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate around 1.25% at its latest policy meeting and stressed that underlying inflation is broadly in line with its 2% price target. While markets widely expect another hike to 1.5% in December, investors still doubt where the BOJ will ultimately steer rates after they reach near‑neutral levels.

In the full text of the October‑end Economic and Price Outlook report, the BOJ disclosed that when assessing the financial environment it looks not only at nominal and real rates but also at stock‑market and exchange‑rate dynamics, which it cannot control directly, and that these have a significant impact.

Regarding the rate trajectory and financial conditions, BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said the decision in October to pause hikes was to “observe a bit more” the economy and price situation, but the board will continue to focus on upward price risks and is highly likely to raise the policy rate to 1.5% in December.

Ueda noted that although overall financial conditions remain accommodative, the BOJ has observed tightening signs in financing conditions for some small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises and will closely monitor whether this spreads further.

Former BOJ official and chief economist at Rakuten Securities’ Economic Research Institute, Nobuyuki Atago, analyzed that, based on the BOJ’s recent messaging, a December hike is “almost a done deal.” He added that the policy path for next year is more uncertain because a further hike could push rates to 1.75%, which may be close to a neutral level for the economy.

InvestingLive analyst Justin Low pointed out that the BOJ’s report raised its FY2027 core‑inflation outlook to 2.6%, indicating that inflation pressures are still building. While the BOJ is still evaluating the transmission effects of past hikes on the financial environment, it will eventually need to act decisively to reassure the market of its policy direction and resolve.

According to BOJ staff estimates, Japan’s nominal neutral rate lies roughly between 1.1% and 2.5%. Because the neutral rate cannot be observed directly and Japan has endured three decades of deflation, firms and households are highly sensitive to higher borrowing costs. In normalising policy, the BOJ must carefully balance preventing inflation from overheating with sustaining the economic recovery.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金回流美元 量增貶值1.14角收32.592元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Capital Flows Back to the US Dollar, Depreciates 0.114 TWD to Close at 32.592
paras: 在美股上周五重挫的壓力下，台股今(2)日表現有撐，但台北匯市表現相對弱勢，資金流向美元避風港，全日處在貶值格局，終場收在32.592元，貶值1.14角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值22.08億美元。
新台幣今日以32.5元、貶值2.2分開出後，匯價越走越低，最低來到32.714元，全日高低價差2.14角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元重挫0.8%左右，新台幣收貶0.35%，日元、泰銖和星元貶逾0.1%，人民幣則逆勢升值0.1%，美元指數回跌約0.1%。
統一投顧認為，台股大盤本益比已降至 16 倍，是近一年低檔，短線急跌實為清洗浮額，為年底前作帳與資金行情做鋪陳，惟短期選舉不確定性仍未消除。
市場關注本周有蘋果、AMD 將公布財報，以及美國期中選舉結果，不過，美伊衝突調解方仍在努力推進重啟談判，且美俄烏最快可望於本周舉行三方會談，短線有助油價穩定。
而美國且即將公布的 ISM 製造業與服務業 PMI ，統一投顧預期保持穩健擴張。
paras_en: Under the pressure of last Friday's sharp drop in US stocks, Taiwan stocks today (2) showed support, but the Taipei foreign exchange market was relatively weak, with capital flowing to the US dollar safe haven; the whole day was in a depreciation pattern, closing at 32.592, down 0.114 TWD, and Taipei FX brokerage transaction volume was US$2.208 billion.
The New Taiwan Dollar opened today at 32.5, down 0.022, and the rate kept falling, reaching a low of 32.714, with a daily high‑low spread of 0.214 TWD.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Korean won plunged about 0.8%, the New Taiwan Dollar closed down 0.35%, the Japanese yen, Thai baht and Singapore dollar each weakened more than 0.1%, the Chinese yuan rose 0.1% against the trend, and the US dollar index fell about 0.1%.

Uni‑President Securities believes the Taiwan stock market P/E ratio has fallen to 16 times, a near‑one‑year low; the sharp short‑term drop is essentially a cleanup of floating capital, setting the stage for year‑end accounting and capital flows, although short‑term election uncertainty remains unresolved.

The market is watching this week’s earnings releases from Apple and AMD, as well as the US midterm election results; however, mediation efforts in the US‑Iran conflict are still pushing for renewed talks, and a three‑way meeting among the US, Russia and Ukraine could be held as early as this week, which would help stabilize oil prices in the short term.
The upcoming US ISM manufacturing and services PMI reports are expected by Uni‑President Securities to show steady expansion.

items.title: 期中大選倒數2天！因應共和黨恐輸國會多數 白宮打算「單幹」　專家：行政、立法選後持續對決
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: 2 Days Left! Facing GOP Fear of Losing House Majority, White House Plans to ‘Go Solo’; Experts Say Executive‑Legislative Clash Will Continue After Election
paras: 美國期中選舉將於當地時間週二(3日)(台灣時間週三)登場，外電最新報導指出，面對民主黨可能奪回國會控制權的風險，白宮已提前數月制定應變備案，研究透過行政命令推進核心政策，並築起法律防線應對國會調查。
《路透社》報導，今年4月起，白宮副幕僚長米勒、預算管理辦公室主任沃特等官員便與法律顧問辦公室合作，整理總統無需國會批准即可採取的行政措施，涵蓋移民、關稅、住房及聯邦支出，法律顧問沙夫(Will Scharf)則在評估法律邊界，研究如何為可能面臨法庭挑戰的決定辯護。川普已聽取彙報，知情人士稱他對「單幹」執政「非常適應」。
具體方案包括對關鍵礦產和風力渦輪機加徵關稅、緊縮國際學生與外勞簽證，以及降低住房成本。各機構已提交法律審查。沃特還計畫修改撥款規則，賦予政治任命官員更大資金分配權，減少對國會撥款的依賴。
目前共和黨在國會僅握微弱多數，民主黨則必須在兩院分別淨增四席即可翻轉。最新民調顯示，民主黨有望贏得眾議院。此前，川普曾稱大選若失利將成為「否決先生」，先否決民主黨法案再尋求妥協。自2025年重返白宮以來，他已多次測試總統權力邊界，包括全面加徵關稅、加強移民執法。
然而，民主黨控制國會後仍有反制手段。參議院民主黨可阻撓司法與行政官員提名；在立法層面，雖然川普否決權難被推翻，但若行政措施越權，法院可介入叫停。白宮已打算向司法部徵求意見，明確行動範圍及訴訟應對策略。
相較於立法僵局，白宮更直接的挑戰是國會調查。眾議院民主黨已準備在奪回控制權後，透過聽證會與傳票，調查川普是否利用職權謀利。
報導指出，白宮律師已開始向官員簡報應對問詢與傳票的技巧，並建議謹慎處理工作記錄，白宮還試圖援引「行政特權」，保護總統與私人顧問的溝通免受審查。
無論選舉結果如何，川普政府正兩手準備：一方面力保國會多數，另一方面則準備在失去優勢後，依靠行政命令與既有撥款強推政策，並迎戰國會調查。行政權與立法權的對決，將在選後持續上演。
paras_en: The U.S. midterm elections will be held on Tuesday, March 3 local time (Wednesday in Taiwan). International reports say that, fearing the Democrats could retake control of Congress, the White House has been preparing contingency plans for months, studying how to push core policies through executive orders and building a legal shield against congressional investigations.

Reuters reported that since April, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Miller, Office of Management and Budget director Whitaker and other officials have been working with the Office of Legal Counsel to compile a list of presidential actions that do not require congressional approval, covering immigration, tariffs, housing and federal spending. Legal counsel Will Scharf is assessing the legal boundaries and figuring out how to defend decisions that may face court challenges. Trump has been briefed and insiders say he is very comfortable with a ‘go‑solo’ style of governing.

Specific proposals include imposing tariffs on critical minerals and wind turbines, tightening visas for international students and foreign workers, and lowering housing costs. All agencies have submitted the measures for legal review. Whitaker also plans to amend appropriations rules to give politically appointed officials greater discretion over fund allocation, reducing reliance on congressional appropriations.

The Republicans currently hold a slim majority in Congress, while Democrats need a net gain of four seats in each chamber to flip control. The latest polls show Democrats are poised to win the House. Previously, Trump said that if he loses the election he will become a ‘veto president,’ first vetoing Democratic bills and then seeking compromise. Since returning to the White House in 2025, he has repeatedly tested the limits of presidential power, including sweeping tariff hikes and tougher immigration enforcement.

However, Democrats would still have checks if they gain control of Congress. Senate Democrats could block judicial and executive nominations; legislatively, although Trump’s veto power is hard to overturn, courts could step in to stop executive actions that exceed authority. The White House plans to seek guidance from the Justice Department on the scope of actions and litigation strategies.

Compared with legislative gridlock, the White House’s more direct challenge is congressional investigations. House Democrats are preparing, once they regain control, to use hearings and subpoenas to investigate whether Trump used his office for personal gain.

Reports say White House lawyers have begun briefing officials on how to handle inquiries and subpoenas, advising careful handling of work records. The administration is also trying to invoke “executive privilege” to shield communications between the president and private advisers from scrutiny.

Regardless of the election outcome, the Trump administration is preparing on two fronts: protecting its congressional majority while also readying to push policies through executive orders and existing appropriations if it loses its advantage, and to fight congressional investigations. The showdown between executive and legislative power will continue after the vote.

items.title: 期中選舉倒數2天！美加貿易談判現轉機　川普：協議已有雛型 加總理：不會趕在選前簽
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: US-Canada Trade Talks See a Breakthrough; Trump: Agreement Already Has a Draft, Canadian PM: No Rush to Sign Before Election
paras: 美國期中大選倒數2天之際，美加貿易談判出現轉機。美國總統川普與加拿大總理卡尼周日(1日)先後表示，雙方已就新貿易協議形成「初步構想」，團隊未來數週將續推細節，但具體條款與簽署時程仍未曝光。
川普周日在愛荷華州表示，前一天再度與卡尼通話，「我們已有協議概念」，聲稱方案有利美國農民與整體利益，但未披露關稅減免等關鍵內容。卡尼也在X平台上發文呼應稱雙方延續「建設性討論」，協議須創造就業、緩解家庭成本，並「充分尊重加國語言、文化與主權」。
美加兩國正磋商下調美對加鋼鐵、汽車關稅的可能性，但未必是全面協議，較可能是擱置部分分歧的「有限安排」。雙方談判曾於8月破裂。當時加國拒絕美國要求，包括削弱法語保護、限制加國與他國簽貿易協定等，卡尼批評相關要求觸碰主權紅線。隨後華府對約200億美元加拿大商品加徵50%關稅，渥太華以報復性關稅反制，衝擊鋼鐵、汽車及跨境製造業，關稅戰也成為密西根等邊境州選戰焦點。
卡尼強調，不會為趕在選前簽約而接受不利加國的條件。他日前受訪時表示，若條款符合加國利益可快速達陣，否則寧可不簽。
與此同時，加拿大加速分散對美依賴。上周加歐峰會宣佈推進供應鏈、國防與關鍵礦產合作，卡尼設定未來十年對美以外市場出口倍增目標。
分析人士指出，美加雙方雖重啟接觸，但鋼鋁汽車關稅、中重型車免稅範圍及主權保障仍是未解鴻溝；在正式文本出爐前，市場宜審慎解讀「初步構想」的分量。
paras_en: With the US midterm election just two days away, a breakthrough has emerged in US‑Canada trade negotiations. President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau both said on Sunday (the 1st) that the two sides have formed a “preliminary concept” for a new trade agreement, and their teams will continue to work out details over the next few weeks, though specific provisions and a signing timetable have not been disclosed.

Trump told reporters in Iowa on Sunday that after a phone call with Trudeau the day before, “we have an agreement concept,” claiming the proposal benefits American farmers and the broader economy, but he did not reveal key elements such as tariff cuts. Trudeau echoed the sentiment on X, saying the two sides are maintaining “constructive discussions,” that any deal must create jobs, ease household costs, and “fully respect Canada’s language, culture and sovereignty.”

The United States and Canada are discussing the possibility of lowering US tariffs on Canadian steel and automobiles, but the outcome may not be a comprehensive pact; it is more likely to be a limited arrangement that shelves some disputes. Negotiations collapsed in August when Canada rejected US demands that would have weakened French‑language protections and limited Canada’s ability to sign trade deals with other countries, a move Trudeau called a breach of Canada’s sovereign red line. Washington then imposed a 50 % tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian goods, prompting Ottawa to retaliate with its own tariffs, hitting steel, autos and cross‑border manufacturing. The tariff war has also become a focal point in the election battles in border states such as Michigan.

Trudeau stressed that Canada will not accept any terms that are disadvantageous simply to get a deal signed before the election. He said in a recent interview that if the provisions meet Canada’s interests, a swift agreement is possible; otherwise, Canada would rather walk away than sign a bad deal.

At the same time, Canada is accelerating efforts to diversify away from reliance on the United States. At last week’s Canada‑EU summit, the two sides announced plans to deepen cooperation on supply chains, defence and critical minerals, and Trudeau set a target to double Canada’s exports to markets outside the United States over the next ten years.

Analysts note that although the United States and Canada have resumed contact, major gaps remain over steel, aluminium and auto tariffs, the scope of duty‑free treatment for medium‑heavy vehicles, and sovereignty safeguards. Until a formal text is released, markets should interpret the “preliminary concept” cautiously.

items.title: AI退燒最危險的不是科技股 德銀警告美元恐掀拋售潮
items.title_en: The Biggest Risk of AI Cooling Isn’t Tech Stocks, Deutsche Bank Warns of a Dollar Sell‑off
paras: AI交易最危險的地方，或許不在科技股，而是在美元。德意志銀行警告，AI熱潮若退燒，恐引發美股與美元齊跌，迫使外國投資人增加匯率避險，進一步加重美元賣壓。海外資金持有逾20兆美元美股，下一輪AI拋售恐從科技股延燒至匯市。
根據德意志銀行估算，外國投資人持有的美國股票資產中，約90%的價值來自累積的價格上漲，而非實際淨買入。
這意味著，龐大的持股部位高度仰賴美股估值支撐，一旦股價大幅回落，資產價值也將隨之縮水。
更關鍵的是，流入美國股市的外國資金，目前已承擔美國經常帳赤字的全部融資需求，使美元與股票市場週期緊密相連。股市若出現大幅修正，支撐美元的資金來源也將直接承壓，讓原本集中在科技股的風險擴散至匯市。
美股跌 美元未必能護身
過去十年，美股下跌時，美元走強往往能替外國投資人抵銷部分損失。但這項保護機制有一個前提，就是衝擊來自美國以外。若風險源頭在美國本身，股票與美元可能同步走低，美元便未必能繼續充當損失的緩衝。
StoneX數據顯示，AI情緒與美元的5日滾動相關係數高達正0.97，20日相關係數則僅為正0.31，反映兩者短期走勢高度同步。
當AI信心動搖，美元也可能跟著承壓，而非像過去部分股市下跌期間一樣，提供避險保護。
因此，這次AI交易的風險不只在於科技股能否守住估值，也在於美元的傳統避險作用是否仍然有效。
不賣股票 也可能加重美元賣壓
對未進行匯率避險的外國投資人而言，美股與美元齊跌，意味著股票虧損之外，還得承受匯損。這種雙重打擊，可能促使投資人重新檢視美股部位的匯率風險。
即使他們沒有賣出股票，只是提高匯率避險比重，相關操作本身也會形成額外的美元賣壓，進一步壓低匯價。
德意志銀行警告，AI拋售潮可能在美股、匯率避險與美元之間形成危險循環。股匯同步下跌促使投資人增加避險，避險操作又加重美元跌勢，使市場承受的壓力超出單純股價回檔。
實質利率是關鍵判斷指標
要判斷這波波動只是部位調整，還是市場正重新評估AI繁榮週期，德意志銀行認為，美國實質利率是關鍵訊號。
該行指出，AI資本支出預期迅速膨脹，是推動美股與實質利率同步走高的重要因素之一。如果科技股、美元與美國實質利率一起下跌，便可能代表投資人開始將更疲弱的AI投資週期反映在價格中。
屆時，市場面對的將不只是科技股技術性修正，而是更廣泛的總體經濟重新定價。相反地，若實質利率維持高檔，股市調整就更可能仍屬部位層面的波動。
AI退燒 美元恐成另一個戰場
面對AI行情可能回檔，最直接的交易是放空科技股。但德意志銀行指出，較不顯眼、卻可能更具影響力的交易，是放空美元。
一旦以美國為中心的股市衝擊成真，外國投資人便可能被迫重新審視逾20兆美元股票資產的匯率避險策略，讓AI交易的影響從股市延伸至美元。
因此，納斯達克指數、美元指數(DXY) 與美國實質利率，將是觀察風險的三項重點。若三者同步走低，市場反映的疑慮可能遠超過一般部位出清，下一輪AI拋售也可能演變成美元拋售潮。
paras_en: The riskiest aspect of AI trading may not be tech stocks but the U.S. dollar. Deutsche Bank warns that if the AI hype cools, both U.S. equities and the dollar could fall together, forcing foreign investors to increase currency hedging and adding further selling pressure on the dollar. Overseas funds hold over $20 trillion of U.S. equities, and the next wave of AI sell‑offs could spread from tech stocks to the foreign‑exchange market.
Deutsche Bank estimates that about 90% of the value of foreign investors’ U.S. stock holdings comes from accumulated price gains rather than actual net purchases.
This means the massive stock positions are heavily dependent on equity valuations; a sharp drop in prices would shrink the asset value accordingly.

More critically, foreign capital flowing into U.S. equities now finances the entire U.S. current‑account deficit, tightly linking the dollar and the equity market cycle. A large equity correction would directly strain the dollar’s funding source, spreading risk from tech stocks to the FX market.
U.S. stocks fall, the dollar may not protect

In the past decade, a stronger dollar often offset part of foreign investors’ losses when U.S. stocks fell. That protection assumes the shock originates outside the United States. If the risk source is domestic, stocks and the dollar can decline together, and the dollar may no longer cushion losses.
StoneX data show the 5‑day rolling correlation between AI sentiment and the dollar is as high as +0.97, while the 20‑day correlation is only +0.31, indicating a tight short‑term sync.
When AI confidence wavers, the dollar can come under pressure too, rather than acting as a safe‑haven as it sometimes did during past equity downturns.
Thus, the risk of this AI trade lies not only in whether tech stocks can hold their valuations but also in whether the dollar’s traditional hedge function remains effective.
Not selling stocks can still add to dollar‑selling pressure

For foreign investors who have not hedged currency risk, a simultaneous drop in U.S. stocks and the dollar means they face both equity losses and foreign‑exchange losses. This double hit may prompt a reassessment of the FX risk in their U.S. equity holdings.
Even if they do not sell stocks but simply increase their hedging ratios, the hedging activity itself creates extra dollar‑selling pressure, pushing the exchange rate lower.

Deutsche Bank warns that an AI sell‑off could create a dangerous loop among equities, currency hedging and the dollar. A synchronized equity‑FX decline forces investors to hedge more, and the hedging adds to the dollar’s decline, making market stress exceed a simple equity pull‑back.
Real‑rate is the key gauge
To judge whether this volatility is merely a position adjustment or a market re‑evaluation of the AI boom cycle, Deutsche Bank says the U.S. real interest rate is the crucial signal.

The bank notes that rapidly expanding AI capital expenditures are a major driver of both equity gains and rising real rates. If tech stocks, the dollar and U.S. real rates fall together, it could signal investors are beginning to price in a weaker AI investment cycle.

In that case, the market would face not just a technical correction in tech stocks but a broader macro‑economic repricing. Conversely, if real rates stay high, the equity correction is more likely to be a position‑level swing.
AI cooling could make the dollar another battlefield
When the AI rally potentially retraces, the most direct trade is shorting tech stocks. However, Deutsche Bank points out that a less obvious but possibly more impactful trade is shorting the dollar.

If a U.S.-centric equity shock materialises, foreign investors may be forced to revisit hedging strategies for over $20 trillion of stock assets, extending AI‑related market impact from equities to the dollar.

Therefore, the Nasdaq index, the dollar index (DXY) and U.S. real rates will be the three key gauges of risk. If all three move lower together, market concerns could far exceed a routine position unwind, and the next AI sell‑off could turn into a dollar sell‑off.

items.title: AI晶片需求推升韓元！第三季狂升13%創近28年新高、南韓央行示警
items.title_en: AI Chip Demand Boosts Won! 13% Surge in Q3 Sets Near-28-Year High, BOK Issues Warning
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續升溫，帶動南韓半導體出口及外資資金流入，韓元今年第三季兌美元大幅升值約13%，創下1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。不過，南韓央行貨幣政策委員會成員Hwang Kunil警告，近期韓元升值速度超出預期，必須密切關注匯率波動，強勢韓元也可能對出口及中小企業造成壓力。
根據《路透》報導，Hwang指出，評估匯率時，應關注波動程度及變動速度，而非僅看匯率絕對水準。他認為，近期韓元升值步伐有些超出預期，央行正密切監測相關變化。
他也提醒，隨著龐大的經常帳順差及外資資產配置調整效應逐漸消退，韓元仍可能面臨貶值壓力。
此次示警正值南韓央行面臨貨幣政策兩難之際。央行本月在連續兩次升息後暫停升息，維持基準利率在3%，但仍保留進一步緊縮的可能性。
韓元升值雖有助降低進口成本、抑制通膨，卻也可能削弱出口競爭力，加上國內消費復甦緩慢及中小企業經營壓力升高，使政策決策更加複雜。

AI晶片需求帶動美元流入 韓元單季升幅創近28年新高

韓元第三季兌美元升值約13%，為1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。Hwang將這波升值主要歸因於全球AI基礎建設投資熱潮，帶動南韓半導體出口及美元資金流入。
隨著AI算力需求快速增加，市場對SK海力士(000660KS) 及三星電子(005930KS) 生產的專用記憶體晶片需求大增，推升南韓出口收入，也為韓元帶來支撐。
Hwang預估，南韓今年經常帳順差可能從央行8月預測的4,500億美元，增加至接近5,000億美元。
不過，他也指出，若全球AI支出放緩，經常帳順差可能減少約500億美元，將對以出口為導向的南韓經濟成長造成衝擊。
儘管如此，他認為，當前AI產業景氣繁榮可能持續更長時間。

強勢韓元衝擊出口 中小企業未能共享AI紅利

韓元升值並非所有產業都能受惠。雖然南韓大型半導體企業受益於AI晶片需求，但匯率走強也會提高南韓出口商品的外幣價格，削弱海外市場競爭力，對出口導向型企業形成壓力。
Hwang指出，出口在南韓經濟中的重要性雖已不如過去，但仍是經濟結構的重要支柱。目前出口表現強勁，卻未能帶動各產業及不同群體同步受惠，民間消費復甦依然緩慢。
他表示，經濟成長帶來的正面效益集中在特定群體，但高利率與高物價卻影響所有人，最終經濟表現將取決於兩股力量何者較強。
中小企業的經營狀況尤其令人憂慮。Hwang指出，南韓中小企業違約率持續上升，國內需求疲弱，企業經營壓力加重。
更值得注意的是，部分企業借款並非用於擴大資本投資，而是拿來支付薪資、原材料等日常營運成本，反映企業資金周轉及財務狀況面臨挑戰。
在此情況下，大型出口企業能夠受惠於AI晶片需求，中小企業卻未必能分享出口成長紅利，還得面對高利率及營運資金壓力，形成不同規模企業之間的景氣落差。

韓元升值有助壓通膨 南韓央行陷政策兩難

通膨走勢也是南韓央行關注的重點。Hwang預估，南韓整體消費者物價通膨率將於2027年上半年末開始接近央行2%的目標，並在2027年底或2028年初完全穩定於目標水準。
韓元升值有助降低進口商品價格，進而緩和通膨壓力，但也可能進一步壓縮出口企業的獲利空間。另一方面，能源價格風險及經濟韌性，仍是央行考慮進一步緊縮貨幣政策的因素。
Hwang被市場視為南韓央行貨幣政策委員會中最鴿派的成員之一，今年8月升息時曾投下反對票。此次公開提醒韓元升值過快，也凸顯南韓央行在穩定物價、維持出口競爭力及支撐國內經濟之間，面臨的政策取捨。
paras_en: Global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure continues to heat up, driving South Korea's semiconductor exports and foreign capital inflows, with the won appreciating about 13% against the dollar in the third quarter, the largest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. However, BOK Monetary Policy Committee member Hwang Kunil warned that the recent pace of won appreciation exceeds expectations and must be closely monitored, as a strong won could also pressure exports and small‑and‑medium enterprises.

According to Reuters, Hwang said that when assessing exchange rates, one should focus on volatility and the speed of change rather than just the absolute level. He believes the recent appreciation of the won has been somewhat beyond expectations, and the central bank is closely monitoring the developments.
He also cautioned that as the massive current‑account surplus and the effects of foreign‑asset allocation adjustments wane, the won could still face depreciation pressure.

This warning comes as the BOK faces a policy dilemma. After two consecutive rate hikes this month, the bank paused further hikes, keeping the policy rate at 3% while still leaving open the possibility of additional tightening.

While a stronger won helps lower import costs and curb inflation, it may also weaken export competitiveness, and combined with sluggish domestic consumption recovery and rising pressures on SMEs, policy decisions become more complex.

AI chip demand drives dollar inflows, won's quarterly rise hits near‑28‑year high. The won appreciated about 13% against the dollar in Q3, the biggest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. Hwang attributes this surge mainly to the global AI infrastructure investment boom, which has boosted South Korean semiconductor exports and dollar inflows.

As AI computing power demand surges, the market’s need for specialized memory chips produced by SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) has risen sharply, lifting South Korean export revenues and supporting the won.
Hwang estimates South Korea's current‑account surplus this year could rise from the BOK’s August forecast of $450 billion to nearly $500 billion.
However, he notes that if global AI spending slows, the current‑account surplus could shrink by about $50 billion, hitting the export‑driven Korean economy.
Nonetheless, he believes the current AI industry boom could last longer than expected.

Strong won hits exports; SMEs miss out on AI gains. The won’s appreciation does not benefit all sectors. While large Korean semiconductor firms profit from AI chip demand, a stronger currency raises the foreign‑currency price of Korean export goods, weakening overseas competitiveness and pressuring export‑oriented firms.

Hwang points out that although exports are less central to the Korean economy than before, they remain a key pillar. Export performance is strong but has not translated into benefits across all industries and groups, and consumer recovery remains slow.

He says the positive effects of economic growth are concentrated in specific groups, while high interest rates and prices affect everyone, and ultimately economic performance will depend on which force proves stronger.
The situation of SMEs is especially concerning. Hwang notes that default rates among Korean SMEs are rising, domestic demand is weak, and business pressures are intensifying.
Moreover, some firms borrow not to expand capital investment but to cover payroll, raw materials and other operating costs, reflecting challenges in cash flow and financial health.

In this context, large exporters can benefit from AI chip demand, but SMEs may not share in export growth gains and must still face high rates and working‑capital pressures, creating a disparity in fortunes between firms of different sizes.

Won appreciation helps tame inflation, putting the BOK in a policy bind. Inflation trends are also a key focus for the BOK. Hwang projects that South Korea’s overall consumer price inflation will approach the bank’s 2% target by the end of the first half of 2027 and fully stabilize at the target by the end of 2027 or early 2028.

A stronger won lowers import prices, easing inflation pressure, but may further squeeze profit margins for exporters. Meanwhile, energy price risks and economic resilience remain factors the bank considers when contemplating further monetary tightening.

Hwang is seen as one of the most dovish members of the BOK’s Monetary Policy Committee and cast a dissenting vote during the August rate hike. His public warning about the won’s rapid appreciation highlights the BOK’s trade‑off between stabilising prices, maintaining export competitiveness and supporting the domestic economy.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元10月上漲 升息預期居高不下
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises in October as Rate‑Hike Expectations Remain High
paras: 美元周五(30日)小幅下跌，投資人因華爾街股市遭遇沉重賣壓而撤出風險資產，轉向美國公債及日元等避險資產。日本銀行(BoJ)決議維持利率不變，但聲明透露一定程度的鷹派立場，也為日元帶來支撐。另一方面，數據顯示歐元區經濟成長放緩，歐元小幅走低。
本週美元、日元與歐元特別受到市場關注，因為聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行（ECB）也都維持利率不變。然而，分析師認為，這並非貨幣政策轉向寬鬆，而是處於一種不安的觀望狀態，尤其在地緣政治動盪推升油價居高不下的情況下。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報101.88。
麥格理全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，AI將成為決定聯準會、歐洲央行或日本銀行哪一家央行會在12月升息的重要因素。
Wizman表示，「從美國、歐元區與日本三大已開發經濟體的經濟成長規模及組成來看，很明顯，2026年AI為美國帶來的助益最大。AI對2026年經濟成長的貢獻，以及2027年至2030年生產力提升的前景，正是華許(Kevin Warsh)希望採取『鴿派』立場、並希望AI持續快速發展的原因。儘管聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）內部存在不同意見，他目前仍不願承諾再次升息。」
他指出，「對歐洲央行而言，AI同樣重要，央行聲明也承認了這點。但歐元區第四季的經濟成長不像美國那樣依賴AI基礎設施建設，因此歐洲維持AI帶動經濟成長的意願不如美國強烈。這也是為什麼歐洲央行仍將能源成本視為貨幣政策的關鍵因素。這也意味著，除非法國出現問題，否則歐洲央行12月升息的可能性高於聯準會。」
他表示，「對日本而言，美國的AI熱潮帶來的經濟成長助益，大於對歐洲的影響。這也是日本儘管遭遇油價大幅衝擊，2026年經濟仍能維持成長的原因。在政府支出發揮作用或油價下跌之前，日本經濟成長的主要動力仍來自科技硬體的外部需求，而非國內需求。如果美國AI類股表現轉弱，聯準會可能暫緩升息，但只要AI帶動的投資維持強勁，日銀就會升息。」
他進一步表示，「事實上，我們認為，日銀12月升息的可能性高於歐洲央行，而歐洲央行升息的可能性又高於聯準會。」
美元指數10月上漲約0.4%，本月聯準會的利率預期成為市場關注焦點。美國消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，加上聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數持續居高不下，使交易員在10月利率決策公布前保持警戒。
不過，FOMC本週決定維持利率不變，華許表示，在12月利率決策出爐前，仍有大量經濟數據有待公布。FOMC已於9月升息，這是三年多來首次升息，而市場目前預期12月還會再次升息。
本月美國經濟穩健成長，以及地緣政治風險溢價居高不下，也為美元帶來支撐。
歐元因GDP數據走低 日元在日銀偏鷹維持利率後趨穩
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1164美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區第三季GDP成長0.4%，低於第二季的0.6%。
受到法國主權債券利差擴大，以及能源進口支出居高不下、拖累歐元區貿易條件影響，歐元10月下跌約0.7%。
歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)證實，決策官員本週曾積極討論是否有升息必要，最後才決定維持基準存款利率在2.50%不變。這番談話使投資人對歐元的信心趨於穩定。
拉加德意外宣布將於明年2月卸任歐洲央行總裁，比原定任期提前八個月。她指出，全球債券殖利率上升正在收緊金融環境，但目前尚不需要央行立即採取干預措施。
日元兌美元小幅走強，至157.62日元。日元稍早一度貶至157.81，整體而言，10月兌美元仍小幅下跌0.1%。
日本銀行以8比1票數決議將政策利率維持在1.25%，但更新後的經濟預測顯示通膨持續存在，強化市場對進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。政策委員Hajime Takata投下反對票，主張立即升息25個基點，將利率提高至1.50%。
這項鷹派異議進一步強化市場押注，認為總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)最快可能在12月再次升息。

paras_en: Dollar slipped slightly Friday (30th) as investors withdrew from risk assets due to heavy sell‑off in Wall Street equities, moving into safe‑haven US Treasuries and yen. BoJ voted to keep rates unchanged but its statement hinted a degree of hawkishness, giving yen some support. Meanwhile data showed euro‑area growth slowing, euro slipped modestly.

This week the dollar, yen and euro were under particular market focus because the Fed and ECB also kept rates unchanged. Analysts say this is not a shift to easing but an uneasy wait‑and‑see stance, especially as geopolitical turmoil keeps oil prices high.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies fell 0.2% to 101.88.
Macquarie Global FX and Rates strategist Thierry Wizman said AI will be a decisive factor in which central bank – the Fed, ECB or BoJ – will raise rates in December.

Wizman said, “Looking at the scale and composition of economic growth in the three major developed economies – the US, the euro‑area and Japan – it is clear that AI will bring the greatest benefit to the United States in 2026. The contribution of AI to 2026 growth and the prospect of productivity gains from 2027‑2030 are why Kevin Warsh wants to adopt a dovish stance and hopes AI continues to develop rapidly. Although there are dissenting views within the FOMC, he is still unwilling to commit to another hike.”

He added, “For the ECB, AI is also important and the central‑bank statement acknowledges this. But the euro‑area’s Q4 growth does not rely on AI infrastructure construction as much as the US, so Europe’s willingness to let AI drive growth is weaker. That is why the ECB still treats energy costs as a key policy factor. It also means that, unless France runs into trouble, the ECB’s chance of a December hike is higher than the Fed’s.”

He said, “For Japan, the US AI boom’s growth boost is larger than its impact on Europe. That is why Japan can still grow in 2026 despite a sharp oil‑price shock. Until fiscal stimulus takes effect or oil prices fall, Japan’s growth will mainly come from external demand for tech hardware, not domestic demand. If US AI‑related stocks weaken, the Fed may pause hikes, but as long as AI‑driven investment stays strong, the BoJ will raise rates.”
He further noted, “In fact, we think the BoJ’s probability of a December hike is higher than the ECB’s, and the ECB’s probability is higher than the Fed’s.”

The dollar index rose about 0.4% in October, with the market’s focus on the Fed’s rate expectations this month. US CPI and PPI both came in above forecasts, and the Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – remains elevated, keeping traders cautious ahead of the October rate decision.

However, the FOMC this week kept rates unchanged. Warsh said that a lot of economic data remain to be released before the December decision. The FOMC raised rates in September, the first hike in more than three years, and markets currently expect another hike in December.
Robust US economic growth this month and a high geopolitical risk premium also support the dollar.
Euro falls on weak GDP data; yen steadies after BoJ’s slightly hawkish rate hold.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1164. Earlier data showed euro‑area Q3 GDP growth of 0.4%, down from 0.6% in Q2.
Driven by widening French sovereign spreads and persistently high energy import costs hurting euro‑area terms of trade, the euro dropped about 0.7% in October.

ECB President Christine Lagarde confirmed that policymakers this week actively debated whether a hike was needed before finally deciding to keep the deposit rate at 2.50% unchanged. The discussion steadied investor confidence in the euro.

Lagarde unexpectedly announced she will step down as ECB president in February 2025, eight months earlier than planned. She said rising global bond yields are tightening financial conditions, but immediate central‑bank intervention is not yet required.
The yen edged stronger against the dollar to 157.62 per dollar. It had briefly slipped to 157.81 earlier; overall in October the yen was down about 0.1% versus the dollar.

The BoJ voted 8‑1 to keep its policy rate at 1.25%, but its updated economic outlook showed inflation persisting, reinforcing market expectations of further tightening. Policy‑maker Hajime Takata cast the dissenting vote, urging an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to 1.50%.
This hawkish dissent further bolstered bets that Governor Kazuo Ueda could raise rates again as early as December.
Derivatives markets currently price roughly an 80% chance of a rate hike before year‑end.
